Celebrations in Smoke#224.src: ... Although, I was caught sleeping while on watch a few times. And my clan got really upset with me for that, even though I promise nothing bad happened.
Celebrations in Smoke#224.dst: ... Dù tôi có bị bắt gặp ngủ gật lúc canh gác vài lần. Thị tộc giận tôi lắm, dù tôi hứa là chẳng có gì xấu xảy ra.
Celebrations in Smoke#224.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#225.src: I wasn't trying to sleep, but it's so hard to stay up all night while nothing is happening.
Celebrations in Smoke#225.dst: Tôi không cố ý ngủ, nhưng thức cả đêm khi chẳng có gì xảy ra khó lắm.
Celebrations in Smoke#225.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#228.src: Oh, uh, well you know. I was, um.
Celebrations in Smoke#228.dst: À, ờ, thì bạn biết đấy. Tôi, ừm.
Celebrations in Smoke#228.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#230.src: And this was the only place I could think of that would have any and I really missed not having to run across the {p} trying to forage and I really really hate being exiled and I need somewhere to go.
Celebrations in Smoke#230.dst: Và đây là chỗ duy nhất tôi nghĩ ra là có đồ ăn và tôi rất nhớ cảm giác không phải chạy khắp {p} kiếm ăn và tôi ghét bị trục xuất lắm lắm và tôi cần chỗ để đi.
Celebrations in Smoke#230.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#231.src: Sorry, I didn't mean to dump all my troubles on you.
Celebrations in Smoke#231.dst: Xin lỗi, tôi không định trút hết rắc rối lên bạn.
Celebrations in Smoke#231.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#233.src: Um. If it wouldn't be too much to ask.
Celebrations in Smoke#233.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#234.src: Would you mind getting me a Fortune Cookie?
Celebrations in Smoke#234.dst: Bạn lấy giúp tôi một cái Bánh may mắn nhé?
Celebrations in Smoke#234.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#235.src: I don't want to burden you or anything and I know I just lied to you and you're trying to investigate me for a horrible crime, but I'm really hungry and didn't get a chance to eat before you all shoved me in here.
Celebrations in Smoke#235.dst: Tôi không muốn làm phiền bạn đâu và tôi biết tôi vừa nói dối bạn và bạn đang điều tra tôi về một tội ác kinh khủng, nhưng tôi đói lắm mà chưa kịp ăn gì thì mọi người đã tống tôi vào đây.
Celebrations in Smoke#235.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#236.src: Thank you so so so so much.
Celebrations in Smoke#236.dst: Cảm ơn cảm ơn cảm ơn bạn.
Celebrations in Smoke#236.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#237.src: Thank you! I don't think I've had one of these since I was a kid.
Celebrations in Smoke#237.dst: Cảm ơn! Hình như từ bé đến giờ tôi chưa ăn lại cái này.
Celebrations in Smoke#237.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#238.src: Here, let me read my fortune to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#238.dst: Đây, tôi đọc lời tiên đoán cho bạn.
Celebrations in Smoke#238.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#239.src: "Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem."
Celebrations in Smoke#239.dst: "Coi chừng vài người thân cận nhất! Họ có thể không như vẻ ngoài."
Celebrations in Smoke#239.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#240.src: That, uh, would have been more useful a couple weeks ago.
Celebrations in Smoke#240.dst: Câu đó, ờ, giá mà có từ vài tuần trước.
Celebrations in Smoke#240.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#241.dst: Xin lỗi vì đã nhờ vả.
Celebrations in Smoke#241.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#242.src: Sorry. Please don't think I did whatever I can tell you think I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#242.dst: Xin lỗi. Làm ơn đừng nghĩ tôi đã làm cái việc tôi biết bạn nghĩ tôi làm.
Celebrations in Smoke#242.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#243.src: Burick. I'm simply a humble green tea trader.
Celebrations in Smoke#243.dst: Burick. Tôi chỉ là kẻ buôn trà xanh quèn.

Celebrations in Smoke#244.src: I don't know what happened, I wasn't involved, and that's all I have to say.
Celebrations in Smoke#244.dst: Tôi không biết chuyện gì xảy ra, tôi không dính líu, và tôi chỉ có thế để nói.
Celebrations in Smoke#244.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#245.dst: Tự hiểu được mà, tôi tưởng vậy.
Celebrations in Smoke#245.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#246.src: I found this burnt medallion, confirming what I was told by a former clan member of yours. You were exiled for theft.
Celebrations in Smoke#246.dst: Tôi tìm thấy mề đay cháy này, khớp với lời một người cũ trong thị tộc của bạn. Bạn bị trục xuất vì ăn trộm.

Celebrations in Smoke#247.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who buys a lot of green tea. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#247.dst: Chừng đó đủ để lần theo nếu bạn tìm được ai mua nhiều trà xanh. Muốn biết thêm thì bạn có thể tiếp tục thẩm vấn.

similar.text: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who was observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.

Celebrations in Smoke#248.src: One clan wants to get rid of stuff, while another clan wants to get their hands on it.
Celebrations in Smoke#248.dst: Một thị tộc muốn bỏ bớt đồ, thị tộc khác lại muốn có nó.
Celebrations in Smoke#248.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#249.src: The {p} is a big and dangerous place. They need a trader to make it happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#249.dst: {p} rộng lớn và nguy hiểm. Họ cần người buôn để làm chuyện đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#249.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#250.src: Yes. Someone has to do it though.
Celebrations in Smoke#250.dst: Đúng. Nhưng phải có người làm chứ.
Celebrations in Smoke#250.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#251.src: Nope. And neither has anyone else I've spoken to.
Celebrations in Smoke#251.dst: Không. Những người khác tôi hỏi cũng vậy.
Celebrations in Smoke#251.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#252.src: I'm not even certain they're real.
Celebrations in Smoke#252.dst: Tôi còn chẳng chắc chúng có thật.
Celebrations in Smoke#252.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#253.src: Don't mention to anyone else that I said that.
Celebrations in Smoke#253.dst: Đừng kể với ai là tôi nói thế.
Celebrations in Smoke#253.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#254.src: Some people get really upset when you imply that.
Celebrations in Smoke#254.dst: Có người nổi giận lắm khi bị ám chỉ vậy.
Celebrations in Smoke#254.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#255.src: The Kalkalrah clan sells it to me. So wherever they get it, I suppose.
Celebrations in Smoke#255.dst: Thị tộc Kalkalrah bán cho tôi. Vậy họ lấy ở đâu thì ở đó, chắc vậy.
Celebrations in Smoke#255.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#256.src: Yes. That's what a merchant is.
Celebrations in Smoke#256.dst: Đúng. Thương nhân là vậy mà.
Celebrations in Smoke#256.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#257.src: I'm not a member of any clan. I travel around selling my products.
Celebrations in Smoke#257.dst: Tôi không thuộc thị tộc nào. Tôi đi khắp nơi bán hàng.
Celebrations in Smoke#257.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#258.src: Clan life would be too stifling. I like getting to see more than the trunk of a single tree.
Celebrations in Smoke#258.dst: Sống trong thị tộc ngột ngạt lắm. Tôi thích được thấy nhiều hơn là thân của một cái cây.
Celebrations in Smoke#258.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#261.src: I'm a merchant, not a member of a clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#261.dst: Tôi là thương nhân, không thuộc thị tộc nào.
Celebrations in Smoke#261.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#262.src: I don't have a way to get one and it hasn't been a problem.
Celebrations in Smoke#262.dst: Tôi không có cách nào để có, mà cũng chưa thành vấn đề.
Celebrations in Smoke#262.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#263.src: I walked closely behind a group that did.
Celebrations in Smoke#263.dst: Tôi đi sát sau một nhóm có mề đay.
Celebrations in Smoke#263.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#265.src: Gives me a good chance to investigate the green tea market too.
Celebrations in Smoke#265.dst: Cũng là dịp tốt để xem thị trường trà xanh.
Celebrations in Smoke#265.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#266.dst: Họ không thật sự tin tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#266.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#267.src: Trades were handled quickly, while the other parties were heavily armed, and in small enough quantities that if I was a changeling no major loss would be incurred.
Celebrations in Smoke#267.dst: Giao dịch diễn ra chóng vánh, bên kia vũ trang đầy mình, và số lượng đủ nhỏ để nếu tôi là kẻ biến hình thì cũng chẳng thiệt hại lớn.
Celebrations in Smoke#267.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#269.src: I did not and I would not hazard a guess as to who did.
Celebrations in Smoke#269.dst: Tôi không thấy và cũng không dám đoán là ai.
Celebrations in Smoke#269.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#270.src: I am answering your questions to the best of my knowledge and ability.
Celebrations in Smoke#270.dst: Tôi đang trả lời hết khả năng và hiểu biết của mình.
Celebrations in Smoke#270.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#271.src: Isn't it your job to figure that stuff out?
Celebrations in Smoke#271.dst: Việc của bạn là tìm ra mấy chuyện đó chứ?
Celebrations in Smoke#271.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#272.src: I see no reason to do your own work and give you more rope to hang me with.
Celebrations in Smoke#272.dst: Tôi chẳng việc gì làm hộ bạn rồi đưa thêm dây cho bạn treo cổ tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#272.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#274.src: I'm cooperating. But I don't see why I should trust someone I don't know or trust with more details than they need.
Celebrations in Smoke#274.dst: Tôi đang hợp tác. Nhưng tôi không hiểu sao phải kể với người tôi không quen, không tin nhiều hơn mức cần.
Celebrations in Smoke#274.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#275.src: It would be helpful for my business if you just let me go.
Celebrations in Smoke#275.dst: Bạn thả tôi đi thì tốt cho việc làm ăn của tôi lắm.
Celebrations in Smoke#275.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#276.src: But I'm not demanding that. You can give me the same etiquette.
Celebrations in Smoke#276.dst: Nhưng tôi không đòi thế. Bạn cũng lịch sự như vậy được mà.
Celebrations in Smoke#276.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#278.src: Sure, but I have no use for your emeralds.
Celebrations in Smoke#278.dst: Được, nhưng ngọc lục bảo vô dụng với tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#278.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#279.src: It's been a while since I've had some rabbit roast. Get some of that for me and I'll see what I can do.
Celebrations in Smoke#279.dst: Lâu rồi tôi chưa ăn thỏ nướng. Mua cho tôi ít đi rồi tôi xem có giúp được gì không.
Celebrations in Smoke#279.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#280.src: Huh. I didn't think you actually would, thanks.
Celebrations in Smoke#280.dst: Hừ. Không ngờ bạn làm thật, cảm ơn.
Celebrations in Smoke#280.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#281.src: Anyway, I'm terse because I'm used to being. It doesn't really have anything to do with you.
Celebrations in Smoke#281.dst: Dù sao thì tôi cộc lốc vì quen vậy rồi. Chẳng liên quan gì đến bạn.
Celebrations in Smoke#281.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#282.src: I spend so much time alone by myself in the woods that I'm not used to making conversation, even when it's needed.
Celebrations in Smoke#282.dst: Tôi ở một mình trong rừng nhiều quá nên không quen trò chuyện, kể cả khi cần.
Celebrations in Smoke#282.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#283.src: Sorry, you seem nice, I wish I could be of more use to your investigation.
Celebrations in Smoke#283.dst: Xin lỗi, bạn có vẻ tốt bụng, ước gì tôi giúp được cuộc điều tra nhiều hơn.
Celebrations in Smoke#283.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#284.src: I have enough of them as is.
Celebrations in Smoke#284.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#285.src: Most of the time I trade in kind anyway.
Celebrations in Smoke#285.dst: Phần lớn tôi đổi hàng lấy hàng.
Celebrations in Smoke#285.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#288.src: I don't know and you're not getting a guess out of me.
Celebrations in Smoke#288.dst: Tôi không biết và bạn đừng hòng bắt tôi đoán.
Celebrations in Smoke#288.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#289.src: I could have missed something, but I didn't see any of us do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#289.dst: Có thể tôi bỏ sót, nhưng tôi không thấy ai trong chúng tôi làm.
Celebrations in Smoke#289.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#290.src: Find someone who might be familiar with a green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#290.dst: Tìm ai đó có thể biết một thương nhân trà xanh.

Celebrations in Smoke#293.src: Please, tell me, I would love to know. I've been searching for one for years.
Celebrations in Smoke#293.dst: Làm ơn nói đi, tôi rất muốn biết. Tôi tìm mấy năm nay rồi.
Celebrations in Smoke#293.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#294.src: The closest I got was some odd tent in the woods east of {p} with a box of the stuff, but that just a scavenger's tent.
Celebrations in Smoke#294.dst: Gần nhất là một cái lều lạ trong rừng phía đông {p} có một hộp trà, nhưng đó chỉ là lều của dân lượm lặt.
Celebrations in Smoke#294.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#295.src: I wish the Kalkalrah clan wouldn't keep the secret so well hidden.
Celebrations in Smoke#295.dst: Ước gì thị tộc Kalkalrah không giấu bí mật kỹ thế.
Celebrations in Smoke#295.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#296.src: No, of course not. They keep it a secret, hoarding it up all year, so they can charge us extra during the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#296.dst: Không, dĩ nhiên là không. Họ giữ bí mật, tích trữ cả năm để đến lễ hội chém giá chúng tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#296.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#297.src: They do all this under the guise of it being "mystical" and "only suited for ceremonial occasions like this," but everyone sees through their sales techniques.
Celebrations in Smoke#297.dst: Họ làm thế với cái cớ trà là thứ "huyền bí" và "chỉ hợp cho dịp nghi lễ như thế này", nhưng ai cũng thấy rõ mánh bán hàng của họ.
Celebrations in Smoke#297.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#298.src: ... not that it stops me from buying every bottle I can get my hands on. It feels amazing.
Celebrations in Smoke#298.dst: ... nói vậy chứ tôi vẫn mua hết mọi chai kiếm được. Cảm giác tuyệt lắm.
Celebrations in Smoke#298.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#300.src: Okay, you have to be holding out on me.
Celebrations in Smoke#300.dst: Thôi nào, chắc bạn đang giấu tôi gì đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#300.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#301.src: Come on, give me the name. What do you want, emeralds? Information? I'll give it to you, just tell me where I can find a year round green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#301.dst: Nói đi, cho tôi cái tên. Bạn muốn gì, ngọc lục bảo? Thông tin? Tôi đưa hết, chỉ cần nói tôi tìm người bán trà xanh quanh năm ở đâu.
Celebrations in Smoke#301.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#302.src: What are you wasting my time for then?
Celebrations in Smoke#302.dst: Vậy bạn phí thời gian của tôi làm gì?
Celebrations in Smoke#302.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#303.src: If you get any leads on that tea trader, make sure to let me know right away.
Celebrations in Smoke#303.dst: Có manh mối gì về người buôn trà đó thì báo tôi ngay nhé.
Celebrations in Smoke#303.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#304.src: Are you sure you're a green
Celebrations in Smoke#304.dst: Bạn chắc là dân buôn trà

Celebrations in Smoke#305.src: You must not have spoken to the people I sold to then.
Celebrations in Smoke#305.dst: Vậy là bạn chưa hỏi những người tôi bán hàng rồi.
Celebrations in Smoke#305.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#306.src: Not sure how much of an enthusiast they could be if they don't know me.
Celebrations in Smoke#306.dst: Mê trà cỡ nào mà lại không biết tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#306.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#307.src: Even so, that's only the words of one person. I won't pretend to know everyone in the {p}. Even the ones I do meet I don't make a major impression on.
Celebrations in Smoke#307.dst: Dù vậy, đó chỉ là lời một người. Tôi không dám nhận là biết hết mọi người ở {p}. Kể cả người tôi gặp cũng chẳng nhớ tôi mấy.
Celebrations in Smoke#307.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#310.src: Search for a camp east of {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] that Burick might have been spotted at.
Celebrations in Smoke#310.dst: Tìm một khu trại ở phía đông {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] nơi Burick có thể đã bị bắt gặp.

Celebrations in Smoke#312.src: What else would I need? I'm sure while you were violating my privacy you snooped through my stuff. I have nothing to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#312.dst: Tôi còn cần gì nữa? Chắc lúc xâm phạm đời tư tôi, bạn đã lục đồ của tôi rồi. Tôi chẳng có gì phải giấu.
Celebrations in Smoke#312.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#313.src: There simply isn't much excess gear that I need as a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#313.dst: Làm thương nhân thì tôi chẳng cần nhiều đồ dư thừa.
Celebrations in Smoke#313.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#314.src: You're not believing that, are you.
Celebrations in Smoke#314.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#315.src: Fine. I'm not really a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#315.dst: Thôi. Tôi chẳng phải thương nhân.
Celebrations in Smoke#315.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#316.src: I'm a scavenger. I was born without a clan and have lived my entire life without one.
Celebrations in Smoke#316.dst: Tôi là dân lượm lặt. Tôi sinh ra đã không có thị tộc và sống cả đời như vậy.
Celebrations in Smoke#316.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#317.src: When pressed, I pose as a merchant. I've spent enough time wandering the {p} that I have enough knowledge to be one.
Celebrations in Smoke#317.dst: Khi bị dồn, tôi giả làm thương nhân. Tôi lang bạt ở {p} đủ lâu để đủ hiểu biết đóng vai đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#317.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#318.src: Still though, that's all. I won't pretend I didn't lie to you, but beside that I'm telling the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#318.dst: Nhưng chỉ vậy thôi. Tôi không chối là đã nói dối, nhưng ngoài chuyện đó ra tôi nói thật.
Celebrations in Smoke#318.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#319.src: I don't know who tried to burn down the wickerman or why. It certainly wasn't me.
Celebrations in Smoke#319.dst: Tôi không biết ai định đốt hình nhân rơm hay vì sao. Chắc chắn không phải tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#319.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#320.src: There's not much to do out in the wilderness. Only so many times I can forage the same bush for food or admire the same river.
Celebrations in Smoke#320.dst: Ngoài hoang dã chẳng có gì nhiều để làm. Hái mãi một bụi cây, ngắm mãi một dòng sông thì cũng chán.
Celebrations in Smoke#320.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#321.src: I get lonely. I still am lonely.
Celebrations in Smoke#321.dst: Tôi thấy cô đơn. Giờ vẫn cô đơn.
Celebrations in Smoke#321.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#322.src: The festival is the only time of year I really get to be with others, I've been attending for years now.
Celebrations in Smoke#322.dst: Lễ hội là dịp duy nhất trong năm tôi được ở bên người khác, tôi đến dự nhiều năm rồi.
Celebrations in Smoke#322.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#323.src: Not that I can speak to anyone much. They might realize I'm not supposed to be here.
Celebrations in Smoke#323.dst: Dù tôi chẳng dám nói chuyện nhiều. Họ có thể nhận ra tôi không được phép ở đây.
Celebrations in Smoke#323.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#324.src: How did you actually get in?
Celebrations in Smoke#324.dst: Thật ra bạn vào bằng cách nào?
Celebrations in Smoke#324.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#325.src: I've managed to find a spot in the {p} wall where you can leap over and the guards can't see. I'm amazed they haven't fixed it yet.
Celebrations in Smoke#325.dst: Tôi tìm được một chỗ trên tường {p} có thể nhảy qua mà lính gác không thấy. Lạ là họ vẫn chưa sửa.
Celebrations in Smoke#325.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#326.src: Come to think of it, if someone else was coming here uninvited, that's probably how they got in too.
Celebrations in Smoke#326.dst: Nghĩ lại thì, nếu còn ai khác vào đây không mời, chắc cũng vào lối đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#326.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#328.src: I found it lying on the ground a few weeks ago, cracked open and half empty.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.dst: Tôi thấy nó nằm dưới đất vài tuần trước, nứt toác và vơi một nửa.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#329.src: Someone must have lost it or something, maybe a patrol of soldiers? That would be odd though, they're usually quite tidy.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.dst: Chắc ai đó làm rơi, có khi là một toán lính tuần? Nhưng thế thì lạ, họ thường gọn gàng lắm.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#330.src: It could have been one of the clans too. At least one of them knows how to produce the stuff.
Celebrations in Smoke#330.dst: Cũng có thể là của một thị tộc. Ít nhất một thị tộc biết làm ra thứ này.
Celebrations in Smoke#330.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#331.src: I don't know, but I'm glad I found it! It's been too long since I've managed to drink any.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.dst: Tôi không biết, nhưng may mà nhặt được! Lâu lắm rồi tôi chưa được uống.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#332.src: I hope you didn't confiscate it while you were snooping through my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#332.dst: Mong là bạn không tịch thu nó lúc lục lọi nhà tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#332.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#333.src: My parents were exiled, I think?
Celebrations in Smoke#333.dst: Bố mẹ tôi bị trục xuất, hình như vậy?
Celebrations in Smoke#333.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#334.src: I've never really gotten the entirety of that story, so I'm unsure.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.dst: Tôi chưa từng được nghe trọn câu chuyện, nên không chắc.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#335.src: I don't really feel like going deeper into it than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#335.dst: Tôi không muốn đào sâu hơn thế.
Celebrations in Smoke#335.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#336.src: It's nice to meet you too. I'm Cerisa, a petty thief.
Celebrations in Smoke#336.dst: Rất vui được gặp bạn. Tôi là Cerisa, một tên trộm vặt.

Celebrations in Smoke#337.src: I snuck into the festival to snag shiny trinkets and whatever else I could get my hands on.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.dst: Tôi lẻn vào lễ hội để thó mấy món đồ lấp lánh và bất cứ thứ gì vớ được.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#338.src: I was also completely uninvolved in who or what tried to burn down the wickerman, so you can let me go whenever you're ready to.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.dst: Tôi cũng hoàn toàn không liên quan đến kẻ nào hay thứ gì đã định đốt hình nhân rơm, nên bạn thả tôi lúc nào cũng được.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#339.src: Did you have anything else you wanted to know?
Celebrations in Smoke#339.dst: Bạn còn muốn biết gì nữa không?
Celebrations in Smoke#339.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#341.src: Because you'd figure it out one way or another, I don't have a more respectable occupation to cover it up with that you wouldn't quickly disprove.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.dst: Vì đằng nào bạn cũng phát hiện, tôi chẳng có nghề nào đàng hoàng hơn để che đậy mà bạn không vạch trần ngay.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#342.src: It'd be irrational to hide my criminal nature when that is precisely what you're searching for.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.dst: Giấu bản chất tội phạm của mình là phi lý khi đó đúng là thứ bạn đang tìm.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#343.src: If I deceived you and you found out, you would surely take it as evidence that I had even more to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#343.dst: Nếu tôi lừa bạn rồi bạn phát hiện, chắc chắn bạn sẽ coi đó là bằng chứng tôi còn giấu nhiều hơn.
Celebrations in Smoke#343.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#344.src: My solitary purpose right now is to convince you that I did not try to burn the effigy. I can deal with the consequences of being exposed as a thief later.
Celebrations in Smoke#344.dst: Mục đích duy nhất của tôi lúc này là thuyết phục bạn rằng tôi không định đốt hình nhân. Chuyện bị lộ là kẻ trộm tôi tính sau.
Celebrations in Smoke#344.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#345.src: Of course not, that would be contrary to my overall purpose.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.dst: Dĩ nhiên là không, thế là đi ngược mục đích của tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#346.src: Mind you, I don't expect you to believe me when I say that. You should definitely act as though I am lying to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#346.dst: Nói trước, tôi không mong bạn tin khi tôi nói vậy. Bạn cứ nên hành xử như thể tôi đang nói dối.
Celebrations in Smoke#346.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#347.src: But I won't. You trusting me is my best ticket out of this mess.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.dst: Nhưng tôi không dối. Bạn tin tôi là lối thoát tốt nhất của tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#348.src: I do. I have no idea what they'd do to me and I don't want to find out.
Celebrations in Smoke#348.dst: Đúng. Tôi không biết họ sẽ làm gì tôi và tôi không muốn biết.
Celebrations in Smoke#348.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#349.src: From what I was able to overhear between you and the organizer, it sounds like you're looking for a changeling.
Celebrations in Smoke#349.dst: Từ những gì nghe lỏm được giữa bạn và người tổ chức, có vẻ bạn đang tìm một kẻ biến hình.
Celebrations in Smoke#349.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#350.src: And based on what they do to just an effigy of a changeling, I have absolutely no desire to find out what would happen to me if they actually thought I was one.
Celebrations in Smoke#350.dst: Và thấy những gì họ làm với một hình nhân kẻ biến hình, tôi hoàn toàn không muốn biết mình sẽ ra sao nếu họ nghĩ tôi là một.
Celebrations in Smoke#350.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#351.src: I'll take whatever punishment my thievery gets me and move on.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.dst: Tội trộm cắp phạt sao tôi chịu vậy rồi đi tiếp.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#352.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.dst: Dĩ nhiên, bạn muốn nói gì tôi cũng nói.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#354.src: Of course. I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.dst: Dĩ nhiên. Bạn muốn nói gì tôi cũng nói.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#355.src: Yes. Being outside of a clan, there's no one particularly trustworthy in the {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#355.dst: Đúng. Ở ngoài thị tộc thì ở {p} chẳng có ai đáng tin cả.
Celebrations in Smoke#355.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#356.src: With the changelings, even if I were to find a partner, I don't know how to make medallions and so could never be sure they weren't killed and replaced.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.dst: Vì có kẻ biến hình, dù có tìm được đồng bọn, tôi không biết làm mề đay nên chẳng bao giờ chắc họ chưa bị giết và thay thế.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#357.src: It's much easier this way, I assure you.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.dst: Làm vậy dễ hơn nhiều, tin tôi đi.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#359.src: Whoever I can. For the most part it's the clans, they can be shockingly lazy if you know where you're looking.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.dst: Ai trộm được thì trộm. Chủ yếu là các thị tộc, họ lơ là đến bất ngờ nếu biết chỗ mà tìm.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#360.src: I have stolen a bit from the military when their watch lapses, although that's obviously much harder to pull off.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.dst: Tôi cũng từng trộm chút ít của quân đội khi họ lơi canh gác, dù rõ là khó hơn nhiều.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#361.src: Not personally, no. I've heard some rumors though.
Celebrations in Smoke#361.dst: Tận mắt thì không. Nhưng tôi có nghe vài lời đồn.
Celebrations in Smoke#361.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#362.src: Hard to tell fact from fiction, but they certainly seem to be a nasty bunch.
Celebrations in Smoke#362.dst: Khó phân biệt thật giả, nhưng có vẻ chúng là một lũ đáng sợ.
Celebrations in Smoke#362.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#363.src: I wouldn't be surprised to hear one tried to break into the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#363.dst: Tôi chẳng ngạc nhiên nếu nghe có một con định lẻn vào lễ hội.
Celebrations in Smoke#363.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#364.src: Not directly, no. But of the three of us, I was the farthest from where the flame was kindled.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.dst: Trực tiếp thì không. Nhưng trong ba người, tôi ở xa chỗ lửa bén nhất.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#365.src: I may have seen one of the other two suspects move, but I can't be positive about that.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.dst: Có thể tôi thấy một trong hai nghi phạm kia cử động, nhưng không dám chắc.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#366.src: If I had more information I would of course provide it.
Celebrations in Smoke#366.dst: Nếu có thêm thông tin, dĩ nhiên tôi sẽ nói.
Celebrations in Smoke#366.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#367.src: Ah, have you decided to try and play confrontational?
Celebrations in Smoke#367.dst: À, bạn quyết định chơi bài đối đầu à?
Celebrations in Smoke#367.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#368.src: That's fine, I will reiterate that I didn't do it. Whether you believe me or not, that is the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.dst: Không sao, tôi nhắc lại là tôi không làm. Bạn tin hay không thì đó vẫn là sự thật.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#369.src: My fate lies entirely in your hands, so to speak. You don't have to engage in theatrics to intimidate me, you are exactly as scary as you were before.
Celebrations in Smoke#369.dst: Có thể nói số phận tôi hoàn toàn nằm trong tay bạn. Không cần diễn kịch để dọa tôi, bạn vẫn đáng sợ y như trước.
Celebrations in Smoke#369.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#370.src: Find someone who might have been observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in.
Celebrations in Smoke#370.dst: Tìm ai đó đủ tinh mắt để thấy Cerisa lẻn vào.

Celebrations in Smoke#371.src: Nothing obviously dangerous, but I always keep in mind.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.dst: Không có gì nguy hiểm rõ ràng, nhưng tôi luôn để tâm.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#372.src: I did see something very odd a few hours ago though. By the entrance to {p}, it looked like someone hopped over the fence.
Celebrations in Smoke#372.dst: Nhưng vài giờ trước tôi có thấy chuyện rất lạ. Gần lối vào {p}, hình như có người nhảy qua hàng rào.
Celebrations in Smoke#372.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#373.src: It might have been a trick of the light, but I think I saw them change clothes and shove something under the bridge.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.dst: Có thể là ánh sáng đánh lừa, nhưng hình như tôi thấy người đó thay đồ và nhét gì đó dưới gầm cầu.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#374.src: Those might just be the ramblings of a worried old parent though!
Celebrations in Smoke#374.dst: Nhưng có khi chỉ là lời lẩm cẩm của bà mẹ già hay lo!
Celebrations in Smoke#374.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#375.src: Oh really? That's a shame, I thought I was stealthier than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.dst: Ồ thật sao? Tiếc thật, tôi tưởng mình lén giỏi hơn thế.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#376.src: I'm not sure that's a real revelation though, I've been open to you that that's what I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#376.dst: Nhưng tôi không chắc đó là phát hiện gì ghê gớm, tôi đã nói thẳng với bạn là tôi làm vậy mà.
Celebrations in Smoke#376.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#377.src: Is there anything else you wanted to call me to account for?
Celebrations in Smoke#377.dst: Còn gì khác bạn muốn bắt tôi giải trình không?
Celebrations in Smoke#377.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#378.src: Yes, I had a change in clothes. The clothes I wear on a daily basis are no fit for a cheerful atmosphere like the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.dst: Đúng, tôi có thay đồ. Quần áo tôi mặc hằng ngày không hợp không khí vui tươi như lễ hội.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#379.src: In that case, I appreciate you keeping me up to date on the progress of your investigation. Your commitment to transparency in the judicial process is admirable.
Celebrations in Smoke#379.dst: Nếu vậy, cảm ơn bạn đã báo tiến độ điều tra. Sự minh bạch của bạn trong quá trình xét xử thật đáng nể.
Celebrations in Smoke#379.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#380.src: Search under the bridge around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for something Cerisa may have left behind.
Celebrations in Smoke#380.dst: Tìm dưới gầm cầu quanh [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] thứ Cerisa có thể đã bỏ lại.

Celebrations in Smoke#382.src: That would be because it's mine.
Celebrations in Smoke#382.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#383.src: Your investigation is quite impressive, I'll admit. I was not expecting anyone to find those, I must not have disposed of them properly.
Celebrations in Smoke#383.dst: Phải thừa nhận bạn điều tra khá ấn tượng. Tôi không ngờ có người tìm ra chúng, chắc tôi xử lý chưa kỹ.
Celebrations in Smoke#383.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#384.src: Although you did get a bit lucky, didn't you. If no one had spotted me sneak in, you never would have found them.
Celebrations in Smoke#384.dst: Nhưng bạn cũng hơi gặp may, đúng không. Nếu không ai thấy tôi lẻn vào, bạn đã chẳng bao giờ tìm được.
Celebrations in Smoke#384.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#385.src: I am a deserter from the military, as of a couple days ago. My stop here is a temporary respite to steal whatever I can before disappearing into the {p} as far as I can.
Celebrations in Smoke#385.dst: Tôi là lính đào ngũ, từ vài ngày trước. Dừng chân ở đây để nghỉ tạm, trộm được gì thì trộm rồi biến vào {p} càng xa càng tốt.
Celebrations in Smoke#385.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#386.src: No I didn't. I am a thief who came to the festival in part to steal petty trinkets. Nothing I told you was a lie.
Celebrations in Smoke#386.dst: Không, tôi không nói dối. Tôi là kẻ trộm đến lễ hội phần nào để trộm đồ lặt vặt. Không câu nào tôi nói là dối cả.
Celebrations in Smoke#386.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#387.src: I'll grant that I did not tell you things you might have been interested in knowing, but that is only because you never asked about them.
Celebrations in Smoke#387.dst: Tôi thừa nhận đã không kể những điều có thể bạn muốn biết, nhưng chỉ vì bạn chưa bao giờ hỏi.
Celebrations in Smoke#387.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#388.src: Had you asked me if I was a former soldier, I would have provided you with all the information you are being given right now.
Celebrations in Smoke#388.dst: Nếu bạn hỏi tôi có từng là lính không, tôi đã kể hết những gì bạn đang được nghe đây.
Celebrations in Smoke#388.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#389.src: Yes, it is to a degree. But you have to understand, you trusting me isn't my only strategy to get out of this.
Celebrations in Smoke#389.dst: Đúng, ở mức nào đó. Nhưng bạn phải hiểu, được bạn tin không phải chiến lược duy nhất để tôi thoát khỏi chuyện này.
Celebrations in Smoke#389.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#390.src: It was a gamble to avoid mentioning my desertion. I had to weigh the odds of you finding evidence of my desertion with the danger I might be in by admitting to it.
Celebrations in Smoke#390.dst: Giấu chuyện đào ngũ là một canh bạc. Tôi phải cân nhắc khả năng bạn tìm ra bằng chứng với mối nguy nếu tự thú.
Celebrations in Smoke#390.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#391.src: With hindsight, I bet wrongly, but I don't think my bet was irrational.
Celebrations in Smoke#391.dst: Nhìn lại thì tôi đặt cược sai, nhưng tôi không nghĩ ván cược đó phi lý.
Celebrations in Smoke#391.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#392.src: Had you been a worse investigator or gotten a bit less lucky, it would have paid off immensely.
Celebrations in Smoke#392.dst: Nếu bạn điều tra kém hơn hay kém may hơn chút, nó đã mang lại lợi lớn.
Celebrations in Smoke#392.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#393.src: And I trust that even now, you are a fair enough judicator you will look at the facts and only the facts.
Celebrations in Smoke#393.dst: Và tôi tin rằng kể cả bây giờ, bạn vẫn đủ công tâm để xét sự thật và chỉ sự thật thôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#393.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#394.src: The facts that show I had nothing to do with what you're investigating.
Celebrations in Smoke#394.dst: Sự thật cho thấy tôi chẳng liên quan gì đến vụ bạn đang điều tra.
Celebrations in Smoke#394.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#395.src: You could. And if you did you would be personally and entirely responsible for my death.
Celebrations in Smoke#395.dst: Bạn có thể. Và nếu vậy, bạn sẽ hoàn toàn chịu trách nhiệm cho cái chết của tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#395.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#396.src: Should you choose to, I hope my face haunts your nightmares for the rest of your life.
Celebrations in Smoke#396.dst: Nếu bạn chọn vậy, mong gương mặt tôi ám ảnh ác mộng của bạn suốt quãng đời còn lại.
Celebrations in Smoke#396.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#397.src: But I don't think you will.
Celebrations in Smoke#397.dst: Nhưng tôi không nghĩ bạn sẽ làm.
Celebrations in Smoke#397.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#398.src: I'll admit I struggle to express this in words, but you don't seem the type.
Celebrations in Smoke#398.dst: Tôi thừa nhận khó diễn tả bằng lời, nhưng bạn không giống loại người đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#398.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#399.src: You couldn't really go through with something like that.
Celebrations in Smoke#399.dst: Bạn không thể làm đến cùng việc như thế.
Celebrations in Smoke#399.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#401.src: Military life was too stifling for me. So many direct orders that I can do nothing but obey.
Celebrations in Smoke#401.dst: Đời lính quá ngột ngạt với tôi. Quá nhiều mệnh lệnh mà tôi chỉ biết tuân theo.
Celebrations in Smoke#401.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#402.src: And it was so boring. Most of my time was spent standing still, watching for threats that never came.
Celebrations in Smoke#402.dst: Lại còn chán ngắt. Phần lớn thời gian tôi đứng yên, canh chừng những mối đe dọa chẳng bao giờ tới.
Celebrations in Smoke#402.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#403.src: So I left. I wish them all the best and apologize to Her Majesty for my inability to serve her as I wanted to, but my time soured me on the whole affair.
Celebrations in Smoke#403.dst: Nên tôi bỏ đi. Tôi chúc họ mọi điều tốt đẹp và xin lỗi Bệ hạ vì không phục vụ người như mong muốn, nhưng thời gian ở đó làm tôi chán ghét tất cả.
Celebrations in Smoke#403.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#404.src: Oh, I see you're getting better at this.
Celebrations in Smoke#404.dst: Ồ, xem ra bạn khá lên rồi đấy.
Celebrations in Smoke#404.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#405.src: Yes, the other reason I left was the brutality of it. I do not handle blood well and was unprepared for the amount of blood I would see.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.dst: Đúng, lý do khác khiến tôi bỏ đi là sự tàn bạo. Tôi không chịu nổi máu và chưa sẵn sàng cho chừng ấy máu tôi phải thấy.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#406.src: Most of the time, being a soldier is dull. Mind numbingly so. But the few times it was not made me wish more than anything in the world that I could be bored.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.dst: Làm lính phần lớn rất tẻ nhạt. Tẻ nhạt đến mụ người. Nhưng vài lần không tẻ nhạt khiến tôi chỉ ước được chán.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#407.src: I'm not even sure the violence was wrong, I just cannot participate in it.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.dst: Tôi còn không chắc bạo lực là sai, chỉ là tôi không thể tham gia.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#408.src: Unpleasant life at home. There was nothing for me to stay behind for. The military seemed like my best way out.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.dst: Cuộc sống ở nhà không dễ chịu. Chẳng có gì giữ tôi ở lại. Quân đội có vẻ là lối thoát tốt nhất.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#409.src: I think I would make the same choice again, even knowing how it would end. There's no way I could stay there for much longer.
Celebrations in Smoke#409.dst: Tôi nghĩ tôi vẫn sẽ chọn như vậy, dù biết kết cục. Tôi không thể ở đó lâu hơn được nữa.
Celebrations in Smoke#409.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#410.src: Let me look at that more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#410.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#411.src: No, I don't. The residue smells far more pungent than any drink I recognize.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.dst: Không, tôi không biết. Cặn này nồng hơn mọi thức uống tôi biết.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#412.src: If you found it here, you could try asking around the festival to see if anyone else recognizes it.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.dst: Nếu tìm thấy nó ở đây, bạn thử hỏi quanh lễ hội xem có ai nhận ra không.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#414.src: Well, I can tell you it's not definitely not green tea. Not sure beyond that.
Celebrations in Smoke#414.dst: Ừm, tôi dám chắc đây không phải trà xanh. Ngoài ra thì không rõ.
Celebrations in Smoke#414.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#415.src: Hmm... neither of us have seen anyone carrying something that smells like that in.
Celebrations in Smoke#415.dst: Hừm... cả hai chúng tôi chưa thấy ai mang thứ có mùi như vậy vào.
Celebrations in Smoke#415.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#416.src: It would have had to have already been in {p} or they would have had to have arrived even before us.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.dst: Hẳn nó đã có sẵn ở {p}, hoặc ai đó phải đến còn sớm hơn chúng tôi.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#417.src: A broken bottle? It looks kind of like the ones we use for our Bottles of Mist, but the smell is totally different.
Celebrations in Smoke#417.dst: Một cái chai vỡ? Giống loại chai đựng Sương mù đóng chai của chúng tôi, nhưng mùi thì khác hẳn.
Celebrations in Smoke#417.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#418.src: Whoa, that's super cool! I bet those pointy edges could hurt a changeling pretty bad...
Celebrations in Smoke#418.dst: Oa, ngầu quá! Chắc mấy cạnh nhọn đó làm kẻ biến hình đau lắm...
Celebrations in Smoke#418.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#419.src: Recognize it? No, but I wish I did!
Celebrations in Smoke#419.dst: Nhận ra á? Không, ước gì có!
Celebrations in Smoke#419.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#420.src: That smell... I don't recognize it, I'm afraid. It certainly doesn't smell safe!
Celebrations in Smoke#420.dst: Mùi đó... e là tôi không nhận ra. Chắc chắn là chẳng an toàn gì!
Celebrations in Smoke#420.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#421.src: I don't recognize it. Would you mind putting it away though? The smell appears to be bothering a couple of the foxes.
Celebrations in Smoke#421.dst: Tôi không nhận ra. Nhưng bạn cất đi được không? Mùi đó có vẻ làm vài con cáo khó chịu.
Celebrations in Smoke#421.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#423.src: It's vaguely familiar to me, but I'm sorry to say I can't place where from.
Celebrations in Smoke#423.dst: Nghe hơi quen, nhưng tiếc là tôi không nhớ ra ở đâu.
Celebrations in Smoke#423.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#424.src: Whatever it is though, I certainly didn't bring it here.
Celebrations in Smoke#424.dst: Dù là gì đi nữa, chắc chắn tôi không mang nó đến.
Celebrations in Smoke#424.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#425.src: aUm, no, I don't think so.
Celebrations in Smoke#425.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#426.src: Sorry if you were hoping I had.
Celebrations in Smoke#426.dst: Xin lỗi nếu bạn mong là có.
Celebrations in Smoke#426.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#429.src: There's not much distinctive about it though, except for that odor.
Celebrations in Smoke#429.dst: Mà nó cũng chẳng có gì đặc biệt, trừ cái mùi đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#429.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#430.src: No. And we're in the middle of a conversation, please don't interrupt us.
Celebrations in Smoke#430.dst: Không. Và chúng tôi đang nói chuyện, đừng chen ngang.
Celebrations in Smoke#430.speaker: Clan Member

Celebrations in Smoke#431.src: That bottle? Absolutely not, that smell is much more than what this old body could take.
Celebrations in Smoke#431.dst: Cái chai đó à? Không đời nào, mùi đó quá sức tấm thân già này.
Celebrations in Smoke#431.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#433.src: But they paid me pretty good not to say!
Celebrations in Smoke#433.dst: Nhưng họ trả tôi khá hậu để im lặng!
Celebrations in Smoke#433.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#434.src: The only way I would is if I were to really be impressed by someone.
Celebrations in Smoke#434.dst: Tôi chỉ nói nếu ai đó thật sự làm tôi nể phục.
Celebrations in Smoke#434.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#436.src: Ha! I knew you couldn't do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#436.dst: Ha! Biết ngay bạn không làm nổi.
Celebrations in Smoke#436.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#437.src: No hard feelings, nobody can expect to beat me at fox racing though.
Celebrations in Smoke#437.dst: Đừng giận nhé, chẳng ai mong thắng được tôi khoản đua cáo đâu.
Celebrations in Smoke#437.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#438.src: Of course, if you want to try again, you're free to. Just don't be surprised when you get the same result.
Celebrations in Smoke#438.dst: Dĩ nhiên, muốn thử lại thì cứ tự nhiên. Chỉ đừng ngạc nhiên khi kết quả y như cũ.
Celebrations in Smoke#438.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#440.src: You won!? I-I-I've never been beaten!
Celebrations in Smoke#440.dst: Bạn thắng!? T-t-tôi chưa từng thua!
Celebrations in Smoke#440.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#441.src: I don't even know how that's possible, you looked like you were just picking randomly!
Celebrations in Smoke#441.dst: Tôi còn chẳng hiểu sao lại thế, trông bạn như chọn bừa mà!
Celebrations in Smoke#441.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#442.src: Well, fair is fair. You gave me a good show, I'll tell you what I know.
Celebrations in Smoke#442.dst: Thôi, công bằng mà. Bạn cho tôi xem màn hay, tôi sẽ kể những gì biết.
Celebrations in Smoke#442.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#443.src: It's really not that big of a deal, I'm not sure why they paid me to stay quiet about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#443.dst: Thật ra cũng chẳng to tát gì, tôi không hiểu sao họ trả tiền để tôi im lặng.
Celebrations in Smoke#443.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#444.src: While studying the foxes before the races started, I caught some members of the Kalkalrah clan bringing in bottles like those.
Celebrations in Smoke#444.dst: Lúc nghiên cứu lũ cáo trước khi đua, tôi bắt gặp vài người thị tộc Kalkalrah mang vào những chai như vậy.
Celebrations in Smoke#444.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#445.src: I thought they were just green tea, but clearly they're not!
Celebrations in Smoke#445.dst: Tôi tưởng chỉ là trà xanh, nhưng rõ ràng là không!
Celebrations in Smoke#445.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#446.src: I'm not positive where they are now, but I think I saw them head up the zipline to the second floor of {p}?
Celebrations in Smoke#446.dst: Tôi không chắc giờ họ ở đâu, nhưng hình như tôi thấy họ đi dây trượt lên tầng hai của {p}?
Celebrations in Smoke#446.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#447.src: And if you'd teach me your racing technique at some point, I'd really appreciate it!
Celebrations in Smoke#447.dst: Và nếu lúc nào đó bạn dạy tôi bí quyết đua của bạn thì tôi biết ơn lắm!
Celebrations in Smoke#447.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#448.src: Be careful what accusations you throw around.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.dst: Cẩn thận với những lời buộc tội bạn tung ra.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#449.src: Not everyone has their guard down around this festival for those who stick their noses where they don't belong.
Celebrations in Smoke#449.dst: Ở lễ hội này, không phải ai cũng lơ là với kẻ chõ mũi vào chuyện không phải của mình.
Celebrations in Smoke#449.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#450.src: Give me that, let me look at what you were showing them more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#450.dst: Đưa bà cái đó, để bà xem kỹ thứ cháu vừa cho họ xem.
Celebrations in Smoke#450.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#451.src: Ahhh, yes, you know something about that group, don't you?
Celebrations in Smoke#451.dst: Àaa, phải rồi, cháu biết gì đó về nhóm kia, đúng không?
Celebrations in Smoke#451.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#452.src: You don't need to tell me, I know as much as you do and more.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.dst: Cháu không cần kể đâu, bà biết bằng cháu, thậm chí hơn.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#453.src: It's been many years since I was able to freely move about the city, my old age imprisoning me in my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#453.dst: Đã nhiều năm bà không thể tự do đi lại trong thành, tuổi già giam bà trong nhà.
Celebrations in Smoke#453.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#454.src: But I can still sit and watch the scurrying people below. I can see what they all do when they think nobody is watching.
Celebrations in Smoke#454.dst: Nhưng bà vẫn ngồi ngắm người ta tất tả bên dưới được. Bà thấy họ làm gì khi tưởng không ai nhìn.
Celebrations in Smoke#454.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#455.src: It's a sort of power. A way to keep myself grounded, hanging here in the canopy.
Celebrations in Smoke#455.dst: Đó cũng là một thứ quyền lực. Giúp bà bám đất, dù treo lơ lửng trên tán cây.
Celebrations in Smoke#455.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#456.src: I watched you scramble to extinguish the fire and I watched what that group did after the flame was lit.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.dst: Bà thấy cháu cuống cuồng dập lửa, và bà thấy nhóm đó làm gì sau khi lửa bén.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#457.src: I watched as those three outsiders were corralled into custody.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.dst: Bà thấy ba kẻ ngoại lai kia bị dồn lại và bắt giữ.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#458.src: However, I cannot hear the details. I do not know the specifics.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.dst: Có điều, bà không nghe được chi tiết. Bà không biết cụ thể.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#459.src: Tell me what your suspects have done and what you have found. Then, I will give you what you seek.
Celebrations in Smoke#459.dst: Kể bà nghe các nghi phạm của cháu đã làm gì và cháu tìm được gì. Rồi bà sẽ cho cháu thứ cháu tìm.
Celebrations in Smoke#459.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#460.src: A bunch of lying outsiders then. To be expected, it's a pity you can't say they all did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#460.dst: Vậy là một lũ ngoại lai dối trá. Cũng đoán được, tiếc là cháu không thể nói cả bọn cùng làm.
Celebrations in Smoke#460.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#461.src: As for that clique, I suspect they're secretly security for the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#461.dst: Còn cái nhóm kia, bà ngờ họ là an ninh bí mật của lễ hội.
Celebrations in Smoke#461.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#462.src: I didn't see who lit the flame, but moments after it was lit, one of them threw a bottle just like the one you're holding at it.
Celebrations in Smoke#462.dst: Bà không thấy ai châm lửa, nhưng ngay sau khi lửa bén, một kẻ trong bọn ném vào đó một cái chai y như cái cháu đang cầm.
Celebrations in Smoke#462.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#463.src: It must have been filled with fuel, because after it hit the flame grew much larger.
Celebrations in Smoke#463.dst: Chắc nó đựng đầy dầu, vì trúng vào là lửa bùng to hẳn.
Celebrations in Smoke#463.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#464.src: Probably for the best, you never know what vermin you can roast if you're not afraid to burn the bush.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.dst: Có khi thế lại hay, chẳng biết sẽ nướng được lũ sâu bọ nào nếu không ngại đốt bụi rậm.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#465.src: If you will entertain an old woman, then I have no use for you. Quit blocking my view.
Celebrations in Smoke#465.dst: Nếu cháu chỉ đến mua vui cho bà già này thì bà chẳng cần cháu. Đừng che tầm nhìn của bà.
Celebrations in Smoke#465.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#466.src: My investigator has returned. Now, tell me what you know.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.dst: Thám tử của bà về rồi. Nào, kể bà nghe cháu biết gì.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#467.src: You look like you have something on your mind, what is it?
Celebrations in Smoke#467.dst: Trông bạn có vẻ đang bận tâm điều gì, chuyện gì vậy?
Celebrations in Smoke#467.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#468.src: Ah, I see your investigations have borne fruit.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.dst: À, xem ra cuộc điều tra của bạn đã có kết quả.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#469.src: Yes. As you have seen, people tend to let their guard down at the festival in a way they normally wouldn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.dst: Đúng. Như bạn thấy, ở lễ hội người ta hay lơi cảnh giác theo cách bình thường họ không làm.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#470.src: They are a necessity to ensure any unexpected guests are swiftly taken care of.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.dst: Cần có họ để mọi vị khách bất ngờ đều được xử lý nhanh gọn.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#471.src: I suspect you're probably right. And yet, that is irrelevant.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.dst: Tôi ngờ là bạn nói đúng. Dù vậy, điều đó không quan trọng.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#472.src: You will tell me they are reckless and a danger to others. I don't disagree, but I encourage you to look at the wider picture.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.dst: Bạn sẽ bảo họ liều lĩnh và nguy hiểm cho người khác. Tôi không phản đối, nhưng hãy nhìn bức tranh toàn cảnh.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#473.src: If we let up our vigilance for even a moment, we have already lost our war. Our clans and families will be infiltrated within the day.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.dst: Nếu lơi cảnh giác dù chỉ một khắc, ta đã thua cuộc chiến. Thị tộc và gia đình ta sẽ bị trà trộn ngay trong ngày.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#474.src: Their recklessness prevents this. In a case where the smallest failure would be catastrophe, recklessness becomes necessity.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.dst: Sự liều lĩnh của họ ngăn điều đó. Khi thất bại nhỏ nhất cũng là thảm họa, liều lĩnh trở thành điều cần thiết.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#475.src: Imagine they had not acted rashly in throwing a bottle of fuel onto the already lit flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.dst: Thử nghĩ nếu họ không liều ném chai dầu vào ngọn lửa đã bén.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#476.src: They did not create the flame, someone else must have been hoping to gain from it.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.dst: Họ không châm lửa, hẳn kẻ khác đã muốn lợi dụng nó.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#477.src: Their actions, while dangerous, prevented any fiends from exploiting the opportunity. We took it out of their control.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.dst: Hành động của họ, dù nguy hiểm, đã ngăn kẻ xấu lợi dụng cơ hội. Ta đã giành lại thế chủ động.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#478.src: Whatever risk their actions created was worth the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.dst: Mọi rủi ro họ gây ra đều đáng cái giá đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#479.src: Apologies for rambling, I assure you though that safety is our top concern. Whatever the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.dst: Xin lỗi vì lan man, nhưng tôi đảm bảo an toàn là ưu tiên hàng đầu của chúng tôi. Bằng mọi giá.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#480.src: Return to the festival organizer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or look into the suspects a bit more.
Celebrations in Smoke#480.dst: Quay lại gặp người tổ chức lễ hội tại [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] hoặc điều tra thêm các nghi phạm.

Celebrations in Smoke#481.src: You think you know who the changeling is?
Celebrations in Smoke#481.dst: Bạn nghĩ đã biết ai là kẻ biến hình?
Celebrations in Smoke#481.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#482.src: You've dug into them all and have found something? Excellent.
Celebrations in Smoke#482.dst: Bạn đã tìm hiểu cả ba và phát hiện ra điều gì? Tuyệt lắm.
Celebrations in Smoke#482.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#483.src: So, who do you think tried to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#483.dst: Vậy bạn nghĩ ai đã định đốt hình nhân rơm?
Celebrations in Smoke#483.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#484.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#484.dst: Nghi phạm {~}? Được. Phần còn lại để tôi lo.
Celebrations in Smoke#484.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#485.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#485.dst: Một lần nữa, cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều. Không lời nào nói hết sự giúp đỡ của bạn đã giúp lễ hội thành công thế nào.
Celebrations in Smoke#485.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#486.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#486.dst: Hãy tận hưởng phần còn lại của lễ hội, và nhớ xem đốt hình nhân rơm nhé! Tôi sẽ giữ cho bạn một chỗ đặc biệt ở hàng đầu để tỏ lòng cảm kích.
Celebrations in Smoke#486.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#487.src: I understand your reticence to pick one. We don't have anything close to the information required to make a proper judgment.
Celebrations in Smoke#487.dst: Tôi hiểu bạn ngần ngại chọn một người. Chúng ta còn lâu mới đủ thông tin để phán xét đúng đắn.
Celebrations in Smoke#487.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#488.src: But you cannot allow that to stop you. We do not have the luxury to close our eyes and pretend it didn't happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#488.dst: Nhưng bạn không thể để điều đó cản mình. Ta không có quyền nhắm mắt làm ngơ như chưa có gì xảy ra.
Celebrations in Smoke#488.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#489.src: Please, from the inevitably incomplete investigation you conducted, tell me who you think lit that flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#489.dst: Làm ơn, dựa vào cuộc điều tra hẳn còn dang dở của bạn, hãy nói tôi biết bạn nghĩ ai đã châm lửa.
Celebrations in Smoke#489.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#490.src: Very well then. I am disappointed, but understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#490.dst: Vậy thì được. Tôi thất vọng, nhưng tôi hiểu.
Celebrations in Smoke#490.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#491.src: I will take care of things from this point forward.
Celebrations in Smoke#491.dst: Từ giờ trở đi tôi sẽ lo liệu mọi chuyện.
Celebrations in Smoke#491.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#492.src: In thanks for saving the wickerman, there will be a seat saved for you when you are ready to watch it burn.
Celebrations in Smoke#492.dst: Để cảm ơn bạn đã cứu hình nhân rơm, sẽ có một chỗ dành cho bạn khi bạn sẵn sàng xem nó cháy.
Celebrations in Smoke#492.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#493.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#493.dst: Tận hưởng nốt lễ hội nhé.
Celebrations in Smoke#493.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#494.src: Keep looking then. Return here once you've made a decision.
Celebrations in Smoke#494.dst: Vậy cứ tiếp tục tìm. Quyết định xong thì quay lại đây.
Celebrations in Smoke#494.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#495.dst: Xem đốt hình nhân rơm tại [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Celebrations in Smoke#497.src: You children of the {p} gather round
Celebrations in Smoke#497.dst: Hỡi con dân {p}, hãy tụ họp lại
Celebrations in Smoke#497.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#498.src: To gaze upon this relic from years past,
Celebrations in Smoke#498.dst: Ngắm nhìn di vật từ bao năm trước,
Celebrations in Smoke#498.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#499.src: This effigy, of ancient foes we fought—
Celebrations in Smoke#499.dst: Hình nhân đây, kẻ thù xưa ta đánh—
Celebrations in Smoke#499.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#500.src: In memory, we will again ignite!
Celebrations in Smoke#500.dst: Để tưởng nhớ, ta lại châm lửa!
Celebrations in Smoke#500.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#501.src: An ancient beast, rebuilt with plank and straw,
Celebrations in Smoke#501.dst: Quái thú xưa, dựng lại bằng ván và rơm,
Celebrations in Smoke#501.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#502.src: What once was flesh, reconstitute as wood;
Celebrations in Smoke#502.dst: Thứ từng là thịt, nay hóa thành gỗ;
Celebrations in Smoke#502.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#503.src: All monsters, old and new, must meet their end—
Celebrations in Smoke#503.dst: Mọi quái vật, cũ hay mới, đều phải diệt vong—
Celebrations in Smoke#503.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#504.src: All fiends must burn! Must broil and char and melt!
Celebrations in Smoke#504.dst: Ác quỷ phải cháy! Phải quay, phải thiêu, phải chảy!
Celebrations in Smoke#504.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#505.src: Substance beside, all that remains persists...
Celebrations in Smoke#505.dst: Xác thịt đi rồi, phần còn lại vẫn tồn tại...
Celebrations in Smoke#505.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#506.src: ...as blackened corpse, no threat there can exist!
Celebrations in Smoke#506.dst: ...thành xác cháy đen, chẳng còn hiểm họa nào!
Celebrations in Smoke#506.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#507.src: Oh, hi, I never got the chance to thank you.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.dst: Ồ, chào, tôi chưa có dịp cảm ơn bạn.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#508.src: I'm not sure what happened after you left.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.dst: Tôi không rõ chuyện gì xảy ra sau khi bạn đi.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#509.src: The festival organizer came back and took Burick/Cerisa away with him.
Celebrations in Smoke#509.dst: Người tổ chức lễ hội quay lại và dẫn Burick/Cerisa đi theo ông ta.
Celebrations in Smoke#509.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#510.src: I'm not sure what happened but, um, I don't think it was good.
Celebrations in Smoke#510.dst: Tôi không rõ chuyện gì nhưng, ừm, chắc chẳng tốt đẹp gì.
Celebrations in Smoke#510.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#511.src: So, thank you again. I wasn't really in the right mind enough to show it then.
Celebrations in Smoke#511.dst: Nên cảm ơn bạn lần nữa. Lúc đó tôi chưa đủ tỉnh táo để nói ra.
Celebrations in Smoke#511.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#513.src: I'll see how long I can hang around here, but the locals are beginning to glare at me a bit.
Celebrations in Smoke#513.dst: Tôi sẽ xem ở lại đây được bao lâu, nhưng dân ở đây bắt đầu lườm tôi rồi.
Celebrations in Smoke#513.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#514.src: I might try to head deeper into the woods, see if there's anything I can find.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.dst: Có thể tôi sẽ vào sâu trong rừng, xem tìm được gì không.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#515.src: Or join the military? I don't think I'd be very good at it and I don't even think they'd accept me, but it might be worth a shot.
Celebrations in Smoke#515.dst: Hoặc gia nhập quân đội? Chắc tôi không giỏi, mà có khi họ cũng chẳng nhận, nhưng cũng đáng thử.
Celebrations in Smoke#515.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#516.src: Otherwise, all I can do is try to live off of what I can find. I, uh, don't like my chances with that.
Celebrations in Smoke#516.dst: Không thì tôi chỉ còn cách sống nhờ những gì tìm được. Tôi, ờ, chẳng mấy tin vào cửa đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#516.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#517.src: I am! I'm always a, uh, little nervous. But a lot less than I was.
Celebrations in Smoke#517.dst: Có chứ! Tôi lúc nào cũng, ờ, hơi lo. Nhưng đỡ hơn trước nhiều.
Celebrations in Smoke#517.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#518.src: It felt like the axe that had been pressed against my neck was lifted, thanks to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#518.dst: Nhờ bạn mà như thể lưỡi rìu kề cổ tôi đã được nhấc ra.
Celebrations in Smoke#518.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#519.src: There's still a lot of uncertainty, but I no longer feel like I'm scrambling like a rabbit in a cage.
Celebrations in Smoke#519.dst: Vẫn còn nhiều điều bất định, nhưng tôi không còn thấy mình như con thỏ cuống cuồng trong lồng nữa.
Celebrations in Smoke#519.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#520.src: I was still in a bit of a daze, so not really, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#520.dst: Lúc đó tôi vẫn còn hơi choáng, nên không hẳn, xin lỗi.
Celebrations in Smoke#520.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#521.src: She left pretty quick though, she must have been in a hurry to get somewhere
Celebrations in Smoke#521.dst: Nhưng cô ấy đi khá nhanh, chắc đang vội đến đâu đó
Celebrations in Smoke#521.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#523.src: Hello. Please try not to come too close.
Celebrations in Smoke#523.dst: Chào. Làm ơn đừng đến gần quá.
Celebrations in Smoke#523.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#524.src: We can talk from a distance.
Celebrations in Smoke#524.dst: Nói chuyện từ xa cũng được.
Celebrations in Smoke#524.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#525.src: Apologies for the coolness, your help was appreciated.
Celebrations in Smoke#525.dst: Xin lỗi vì lạnh nhạt, tôi rất cảm kích sự giúp đỡ của bạn.
Celebrations in Smoke#525.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#526.src: But I cannot be sure you are who you say you are.
Celebrations in Smoke#526.dst: Nhưng tôi không chắc bạn đúng là người bạn nói.
Celebrations in Smoke#526.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#528.src: Since our run in at the festival, I have been laying lower than usual.
Celebrations in Smoke#528.dst: Từ lần chạm mặt ở lễ hội, tôi ẩn mình kỹ hơn thường lệ.
Celebrations in Smoke#528.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#529.src: My life has not been much different than it usually is.
Celebrations in Smoke#529.dst: Cuộc sống của tôi chẳng khác mấy so với thường ngày.
Celebrations in Smoke#529.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#530.src: It was a horrific mistake to even attend the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#530.dst: Ngay cả việc đến dự lễ hội đã là một sai lầm khủng khiếp.
Celebrations in Smoke#530.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#531.src: I allowed myself to be controlled by my own humanity; that is a mistake the {p} rarely lets off easily.
Celebrations in Smoke#531.dst: Tôi đã để tính người lấn át mình; {p} hiếm khi bỏ qua sai lầm đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#531.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#532.src: I will not make the same mistake again. Loneliness will hurt, but trust will kill.
Celebrations in Smoke#532.dst: Tôi sẽ không phạm lại sai lầm đó. Cô đơn thì đau, nhưng lòng tin thì giết người.
Celebrations in Smoke#532.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#533.src: Last I saw, they were still in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#533.dst: Lần cuối tôi thấy, Arris vẫn ở {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#533.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#534.src: They don't seem cut out for the life of a scavenger, if they can't find any other way to live outside a clan they'll be dead within the week.
Celebrations in Smoke#534.dst: Arris có vẻ không hợp sống kiểu dân lượm lặt, nếu không tìm được cách khác để sống ngoài thị tộc thì chẳng quá một tuần là chết.
Celebrations in Smoke#534.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#535.dst: Thật đáng tiếc, nhưng thực tế là vậy.
Celebrations in Smoke#535.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#536.src: Yes, while everyone else was watching the wickerman burn she rustled through as many abandoned stalls, bags, and houses as she could.
Celebrations in Smoke#536.dst: Đúng, trong lúc mọi người xem đốt hình nhân rơm, cô ta lục lọi hết các sạp, túi đồ và nhà bỏ trống mà cô ta vớ được.
Celebrations in Smoke#536.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#537.src: I left before she was finished, but this morning I saw a figure walking south out of {p}, carrying several large bags.
Celebrations in Smoke#537.dst: Tôi đi trước khi cô ta xong, nhưng sáng nay tôi thấy một bóng người rời {p} về phía nam, mang mấy túi lớn.
Celebrations in Smoke#537.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#538.src: Wherever she's headed, she's prepared for a long trek.
Celebrations in Smoke#538.dst: Dù đi đâu, cô ta cũng đã chuẩn bị cho chuyến đi dài.
Celebrations in Smoke#538.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#540.src: Now that you have a mask, you can enjoy the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#540.dst: Giờ có mặt nạ rồi, bạn có thể tận hưởng lễ hội.

Celebrations in Smoke#541.src: Do you want to wear the deer mask?
Celebrations in Smoke#541.dst: Bạn muốn đeo mặt nạ hươu không?

Celebrations in Smoke#542.src: You unravel your fortune. It says:
Celebrations in Smoke#542.dst: Bạn mở tờ giấy may mắn ra. Trên đó ghi:

Celebrations in Smoke#543.src: 'You will live a long and prosperous life and will die surrouded by your clan.'
Celebrations in Smoke#543.dst: 'Bạn sẽ sống lâu, sung túc và ra đi giữa vòng tay thị tộc.'
Celebrations in Smoke#543.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#544.src: 'Respect your parents, in your time of greatest need they will come for you.'
Celebrations in Smoke#544.dst: 'Hãy kính trọng cha mẹ, lúc bạn cần nhất họ sẽ đến tìm bạn.'
Celebrations in Smoke#544.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#545.dst:
Người tổ chức lễ hội
Cái gì thế kia!?
Celebrations in Smoke#545.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#546.src:
Festival Attendee
Not right now, but-
Celebrations in Smoke#546.dst:
Khách dự lễ hội
Giờ thì chưa, nhưng-
Celebrations in Smoke#546.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#547.src: What would you like to ask the suspect?
Celebrations in Smoke#547.dst: Bạn muốn hỏi nghi phạm điều gì?

Celebrations in Smoke#548.src: You've updated your notes with this new information.
Celebrations in Smoke#548.dst: Bạn đã cập nhật sổ ghi chép với thông tin mới này.

Celebrations in Smoke#549.dst: Bạn đang theo dõi Nghi phạm {~} rồi.

Celebrations in Smoke#550.src: You're now following the clues related to Suspect {~}.
Celebrations in Smoke#550.dst: Giờ bạn đang lần theo manh mối liên quan đến Nghi phạm {~}.

Celebrations in Smoke#553.src: What would you like to ask Burick?
Celebrations in Smoke#553.dst: Bạn muốn hỏi Burick điều gì?

Celebrations in Smoke#554.src: What would you like to ask Arris?
Celebrations in Smoke#554.dst: Bạn muốn hỏi Arris điều gì?

Celebrations in Smoke#555.src: What would you like to ask Cerisa?
Celebrations in Smoke#555.dst: Bạn muốn hỏi Cerisa điều gì?

Celebrations in Smoke#559.src: Isn't that personally dangerous, for you?
Celebrations in Smoke#559.dst: Thế chẳng phải nguy hiểm cho chính bạn sao?
Celebrations in Smoke#559.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#560.dst: Bạn có thấy kẻ biến hình nào chưa?
Celebrations in Smoke#560.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#561.src: Why don't you have a medallion?
Celebrations in Smoke#561.dst: Sao bạn không có mề đay?
Celebrations in Smoke#561.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#562.src: How did you get into the festival without a medallion?
Celebrations in Smoke#562.dst: Không có mề đay thì bạn vào lễ hội bằng cách nào?
Celebrations in Smoke#562.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#564.src: Why would the clans trust you without a medallion?
Celebrations in Smoke#564.dst: Không có mề đay thì sao các thị tộc tin bạn?
Celebrations in Smoke#564.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#565.src: What do you do as a member of Kalkalrah clan?
Celebrations in Smoke#565.dst: Bạn làm gì trong thị tộc Kalkalrah?
Celebrations in Smoke#565.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#567.dst: Bạn lúc nào cũng lo lắng thế à?
Celebrations in Smoke#567.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#568.src: So what if I think you did do it?
Celebrations in Smoke#568.dst: Nếu tôi nghĩ bạn làm thì sao?
Celebrations in Smoke#568.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#569.dst: Bạn nói chậm lại được không?
Celebrations in Smoke#569.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#570.src: Did you see who tried to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#570.dst: Bạn có thấy ai định đốt hình nhân rơm không?
Celebrations in Smoke#570.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#571.src: Why did you try to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#571.dst: Sao bạn định đốt hình nhân rơm?
Celebrations in Smoke#571.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#572.src: Where do you get your green tea?
Celebrations in Smoke#572.dst: Bạn lấy trà xanh ở đâu?
Celebrations in Smoke#572.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#573.src: Your entire business is selling the products of one clan to everyone else?
Celebrations in Smoke#573.dst: Toàn bộ việc làm ăn của bạn là bán hàng của một thị tộc cho mọi người khác?
Celebrations in Smoke#573.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#574.src: So you won't lie to me at all?
Celebrations in Smoke#574.dst: Vậy bạn sẽ không nói dối tôi?
Celebrations in Smoke#574.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#575.src: Why are you so insistent on not wanting to be found to have tried to burn the wickerman? Do you fear the consequences that much?
Celebrations in Smoke#575.dst: Sao bạn khăng khăng không muốn bị phát hiện là định đốt hình nhân rơm thế? Bạn sợ hậu quả đến vậy à?
Celebrations in Smoke#575.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#578.src: Ask the tea enthusiast a question?
Celebrations in Smoke#578.dst: Hỏi người mê trà một câu?

Celebrations in Smoke#579.src: Search for a camp east of {p} that Burick might have been spotted at
Celebrations in Smoke#579.dst: Tìm một khu trại ở phía đông {p} nơi Burick có thể đã bị bắt gặp

Celebrations in Smoke#580.src: The Kalkalrah clan doesn't sell it normally?
Celebrations in Smoke#580.dst: Thị tộc Kalkalrah thường không bán trà sao?
Celebrations in Smoke#580.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#581.src: No, It's starting to look like there isn't one.
Celebrations in Smoke#581.dst: Không, có vẻ như chẳng có ai cả.
Celebrations in Smoke#581.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#582.src: This is where the fire was started, it looks like all that's left is embers.
Celebrations in Smoke#582.dst: Đây là chỗ lửa bắt đầu, có vẻ chỉ còn lại than hồng.

Celebrations in Smoke#584.src: A bottle? You might want to see if the food stall recognizes it.
Celebrations in Smoke#584.dst: Một cái chai? Có lẽ bạn nên hỏi quầy ăn xem họ có nhận ra không.

Celebrations in Smoke#585.src: Ask the clan member a question?
Celebrations in Smoke#585.dst: Hỏi thành viên thị tộc một câu?

Celebrations in Smoke#586.src: Exiled? They never mentioned anything like that when I interrogated them.
Celebrations in Smoke#586.dst: Bị trục xuất? Lúc tôi thẩm vấn, Arris chẳng hề nhắc chuyện đó.
Celebrations in Smoke#586.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#587.src: How much do you think I can trust them?
Celebrations in Smoke#587.dst: Bạn nghĩ tôi tin Arris được đến mức nào?
Celebrations in Smoke#587.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#589.dst: Chuyện này từ bao lâu rồi?
Celebrations in Smoke#589.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#590.src: Was this the first time something like that happened?
Celebrations in Smoke#590.dst: Đây có phải lần đầu chuyện như vậy xảy ra không?
Celebrations in Smoke#590.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#591.src: Why did you come to the festival?
Celebrations in Smoke#591.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#592.dst: Đưa Arris một Bánh may mắn?
Celebrations in Smoke#592.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#593.src: Sure, let me go get one.
Celebrations in Smoke#593.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#596.src: This looks like the place that festival attendee mentioned.
Celebrations in Smoke#596.dst: Có vẻ đây là chỗ người khách dự lễ hội kia nhắc đến.

Celebrations in Smoke#597.src: The green tea covering the ground seems to indicate the clan member is telling the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#597.dst: Trà xanh vương vãi khắp mặt đất cho thấy thành viên thị tộc kia nói thật.

Celebrations in Smoke#598.src: Maybe you could look a bit more closely though?
Celebrations in Smoke#598.dst: Nhưng có lẽ bạn nên xem kỹ hơn chút?

Celebrations in Smoke#599.src: On the wall is a crude sketch of the surrounding area.
Celebrations in Smoke#599.dst: Trên tường có bản phác thảo thô sơ khu vực xung quanh.

Celebrations in Smoke#600.src: The embers below this cooking pot are still smoldering, it's been used recently.
Celebrations in Smoke#600.dst: Than hồng dưới nồi vẫn còn âm ỉ, nó vừa được dùng gần đây.

Celebrations in Smoke#601.src: You cheer your fox on! It, already under pressure, is overwhelmed.
Celebrations in Smoke#601.dst: Bạn cổ vũ cáo của mình! Vốn đã căng thẳng, nó bị choáng ngợp.

Celebrations in Smoke#602.src: Your voice has recovered and you can cheer again.
Celebrations in Smoke#602.dst: Giọng bạn đã hồi lại, bạn có thể cổ vũ tiếp.

Celebrations in Smoke#603.src: You cheer your fox on! It can't hear you over the excitement of the race.
Celebrations in Smoke#603.dst: Bạn cổ vũ cáo của mình! Nó không nghe thấy bạn giữa không khí sôi động của cuộc đua.

Celebrations in Smoke#604.src: You cheer your fox on! It receives an extra boost of encouragement!
Celebrations in Smoke#604.dst: Bạn cổ vũ cáo của mình! Nó được tiếp thêm động lực!
