The Feathers Fly Part II#167.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#168.src: You two are extremely lucky. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.dst: Hai người may mắn cực kỳ. Tôi không tin nổi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#169.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.dst: Mong sáng mai hai người rảnh, vì không hiểu sao Hội đồng rảnh đúng lúc đó.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#170.src: Sounds good? Hopefully it does, because you don't really have much of a choice. Well, you can leave now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.dst: Được chứ? Mong là được, vì hai người cũng chẳng có lựa chọn. Giờ đi được rồi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#171.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.dst: Không tin nổi là ta đang tiến triển thật! Háo hức quá!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#172.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.dst: Rồi, phải thử máy trước buổi tiếp kiến. Tôi chỉnh lại chút!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#173.src: Let's meet up near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just meet me by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.dst: Gặp ở gần lối vào phía bắc nếu bạn muốn đi nhờ. Hoặc thích đi bộ thì gặp tôi ở Xưởng!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#174.dst: À, chào mọi người! Xin lỗi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#174.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#175.src: So, how do I find help...
The Feathers Fly Part II#175.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#176.src: I sure do love... Money. Totally!
The Feathers Fly Part II#176.dst: Tôi mê... Tiền lắm. Thật đấy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#176.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#229.src: It's difficult to get an audience? Well, it's worth a try, right? Maybe they'll see me as a wealthy lad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.dst: Khó được tiếp kiến à? Thì cứ thử, nhỉ? Biết đâu họ tưởng tôi giàu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#238.src: Why hello there! Greetings! Welcome! You are looking splendid, dear!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.dst: Ôi chào! Xin chào! Hoan nghênh! Trông quý cô lộng lẫy quá!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#239.src: Oh?! T-thank you... That's the first time someone told me such a thing!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.dst: Ơ?! C-cảm ơn... Lần đầu có người khen tôi vậy đấy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#240.src: Don't be silly dear, you're beautiful! Say, you're looking to be an investor, am I right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.dst: Đừng ngốc thế, cô đẹp lắm! À, cô muốn làm nhà đầu tư, phải không?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#241.src: ...Will that grant me an audience with the Council?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.dst: ...Thế có được tiếp kiến Hội đồng không?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#242.src: Why of course! Is that other person your assistant? Great!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.dst: Tất nhiên! Người kia là trợ lý của cô à? Tuyệt!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#243.src: I'd like you to show me you have what it takes to be a great investor, yes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.dst: Tôi muốn cô chứng tỏ mình có tố chất nhà đầu tư lớn, đúng vậy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#244.src: Just hand over a mere [{~} Liquified Emeralds] and it's settled!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.dst: Chỉ cần đưa [{~} Ngọc lục bảo lỏng] là xong!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#245.src: I- We'll... see what we can do.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.dst: Tôi- Bọn tôi sẽ... xem sao.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#246.src: Look, I'm not good at being a human but even I know this is an absurd amount of money!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.dst: Tôi không giỏi làm người, nhưng tôi cũng biết đó là số tiền vô lý!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#247.src: Do you think she'd actually take it? I'm not sure. We might have to find another way...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.dst: Bạn nghĩ cô ta nhận thật à? Tôi không chắc. Có khi phải tìm cách khác...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#248.src: I'll go back to the town center. It's up to you if you want to risk all that money, if you even have it! We'll figure something else out.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.dst: Tôi về trung tâm thị trấn. Có liều số tiền đó hay không là tùy bạn, nếu bạn có! Ta sẽ nghĩ cách khác.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#249.src: Oh, you're back! With the money I see! Surprising! I like you two!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.dst: Ồ, quay lại rồi! Còn mang tiền! Bất ngờ ghê! Tôi quý hai người!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#250.src: What? Of course I'm not taking the money! I just wanted to know if you had what it takes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.dst: Gì? Tất nhiên tôi không lấy tiền! Tôi chỉ muốn xem cô có đủ tố chất!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#251.src: Now I'm sure you're not a scam. Let me see when the council's available...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.dst: Giờ tôi chắc hai người không lừa đảo. Để xem khi nào Hội đồng rảnh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#252.src: Thanks! I'll try not to disappoint you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.dst: Cảm ơn! Tôi sẽ không làm chị thất vọng.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#253.src: You are two lucky people! We do have a free spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.dst: Hai người may thật! Vừa có chỗ trống!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#254.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you! We'll see you there then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.dst: Mong sáng mai hai người rảnh! Hẹn gặp ở đó!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#256.src: That's crazy! [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? Is that how the world works?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.dst: Điên rồ! [{~} Ngọc lục bảo lỏng]? Thế giới này vậy à?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#257.src: It's just... I honestly don't care about listening to the law anymore.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.dst: Chỉ là... Thật lòng tôi chẳng buồn giữ luật nữa.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#258.src: Let's just get that audience. For one, there's some girl panicking by the Armour Merchant! Maybe she could help?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.dst: Cứ lấy được buổi tiếp kiến đã. Có cô gái đang hoảng chỗ Người bán giáp! Biết đâu giúp được?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#259.src: As for another way, I don't know if you paid attention on our way to the receptionist, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.dst: Còn cách khác, không biết bạn để ý không trên đường tới chỗ lễ tân, nhưng...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#260.src: There is apparently a dealer in there. He does charge money too, though. But surely not as much as that... wretched... lady! ...Sorry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.dst: Nghe nói trong đó có gã buôn. Hắn cũng lấy tiền. Nhưng chắc không nhiều bằng... mụ... đáng ghét... kia! ...Xin lỗi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#280.src: Oh! Why hello there you two! How may I be of assistance?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.dst: Ôi! Chào hai vị! Tôi giúp gì được ạ?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#282.src: You're looking splendid dear! Now, are you-- Wait, you have a letter?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.dst: Cô trông lộng lẫy quá! Vậy, cô có- Khoan, cô có thư à?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#286.src: You know miss, you look like you could've been a great investor. Oh well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.dst: Cô biết không, trông cô hẳn đã là nhà đầu tư giỏi. Thôi, chúc may mắn!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#287.src: If you want a tip, well... There's a new guy in the Council, so he might be easier to impress!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.dst: Muốn mẹo thì... Hội đồng có người mới, có khi dễ gây ấn tượng hơn!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#346.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Huh. Well, we should still give it a go? I look fancy, surely they'll listen!
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.dst: Nghe bảo... khó lắm à? Hừm. Vẫn thử chứ? Tôi ăn mặc sang thế, chắc họ nghe!
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#357.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? I need more than fancy clothes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.dst: Có gì để trình bày KHÔNG? Quần áo sang chưa đủ đâu.
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#358.src: Oh, uh, we, well I actually made a, uh, what's it called, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.dst: Ồ, ờ, bọn tôi, à tôi làm ra một, ờ, gọi là gì nhỉ, ờ...
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#359.src: Not Another word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.dst: KHÔNG nói thêm chữ nào! Nghe đủ rồi! Rõ là hai người chả có gì đáng thời gian của tôi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#360.src: And what's up with your face, lady? I'd look into that if I were you! OUT!
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.dst: Còn mặt cô bị sao thế? Là tôi thì đi khám ngay! RA NGOÀI!
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#367.src: Maybe that's our ticket? I don't know, I'm just a law-abiding citizen. Well, actually, about that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.dst: Có khi đó là vé của ta? Không biết, tôi chỉ là công dân tuân thủ luật. À mà, chuyện đó...
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#379.src: Leaving town? I'll stick around, just come back eventually, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.dst: Rời thị trấn à? Tôi ở quanh đây, nhớ quay lại nhé?
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#391.src: Why sure darling, you have {~} seconds to- Hold on, that letter...
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.dst: Tất nhiên rồi cưng, cô có {~} giây để- Khoan, lá thư đó...
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#393.src: You two are extremely luck. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.dst: Hai người may mắn cực kỳ. Tôi không tin nổi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#395.src: Don't miss it. Oh, and miss, there's something really off about your face.
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.dst: Đừng lỡ hẹn. À, cô kia, mặt cô có gì đó rất lạ.
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#396.src: Thank you so much! Sorry about my face, I'm... New in town. Bye!
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.dst: Cảm ơn nhiều lắm! Xin lỗi về mặt tôi, tôi... mới tới. Chào!
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#400.src: Urgh, what now? You better be quick.
The Feathers Fly Part II#400.dst: Hừ, gì nữa? Nói nhanh lên.
The Feathers Fly Part II#400.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#401.src: Wait you... You actually have an invitation letter? ...How...
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.dst: Khoan, cậu... Cậu có thư mời thật à? ...Sao lại...
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#402.src: Wait, WHY do you have TWO letters?? This doesn't make any sense?! Oh well, whatever I'm not paid enough to care.
The Feathers Fly Part II#402.dst: Khoan, SAO cậu có HAI lá thư?? Vô lý quá?! Thôi kệ, lương tôi chả đủ để quan tâm.
The Feathers Fly Part II#402.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#403.src: Oh, wow, you're not gonna believe this. You're a lucky one. Are you alone? No?
The Feathers Fly Part II#403.dst: Ôi, cậu không tin nổi đâu. Cậu may đấy. Đi một mình à? Không?
The Feathers Fly Part II#403.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#404.src: Well, I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time
The Feathers Fly Part II#404.dst: Mong sáng mai cậu rảnh, vì không hiểu sao Hội đồng rảnh đúng lúc đó
The Feathers Fly Part II#404.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#405.src: Sounds good? Well, go tell your partner about this, you are two lucky Corkians!
The Feathers Fly Part II#405.dst: Được chứ? Đi báo bạn đồng hành đi, hai Corkian may mắn!
The Feathers Fly Part II#405.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#467.src: Wow. I cannot stop staring at you... Such magnificent armour.
The Feathers Fly Part II#467.dst: Chà. Tôi không rời mắt nổi... Bộ giáp lộng lẫy quá.
The Feathers Fly Part II#467.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#468.src: Well sir, or miss, if you tried to impress me, you certainly succeeded.
The Feathers Fly Part II#468.dst: Thưa ngài, hay thưa cô, nếu muốn gây ấn tượng thì đã thành công.
The Feathers Fly Part II#468.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#469.src: Why thank you! I reckon you will search for an available time regarding an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#469.dst: Cảm ơn ạ! Vậy chị sẽ tìm giờ trống cho buổi tiếp kiến chứ?
The Feathers Fly Part II#469.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#470.src: Well, you two seem very lucky, there's an available slot soon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#470.dst: Hai vị may thật, sắp có chỗ trống!
The Feathers Fly Part II#470.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#471.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#471.dst: Mong sáng mai hai vị rảnh, vì Hội đồng rảnh vào lúc đó.
The Feathers Fly Part II#471.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#472.dst: Được chứ? Xứng đáng mà, hai
The Feathers Fly Part II#472.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#486.src: Help Ava operate the machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#486.dst: Giúp Ava vận hành máy tại [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#487.src: Hey! I'm back in my original clothes. It feels so much better...
The Feathers Fly Part II#487.dst: Này! Tôi mặc lại đồ cũ rồi. Dễ chịu hơn hẳn...
The Feathers Fly Part II#487.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#488.src: Remember that hill next to the Workshop? We'll work there again. Tell me when you're ready for the lift.
The Feathers Fly Part II#488.dst: Nhớ ngọn đồi cạnh Xưởng không? Ta lại làm ở đó. Sẵn sàng đi nhờ thì bảo tôi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#488.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#490.src: There we are! Talk to me and I'll tell you all about the changes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#490.dst: Tới rồi! Nói chuyện với tôi, tôi kể hết thay đổi cho!
The Feathers Fly Part II#490.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#491.src: Do you remember how it worked last time? Don't worry, it's still fairly similar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#491.dst: Nhớ lần trước nó chạy thế nào không? Yên tâm, vẫn khá giống.
The Feathers Fly Part II#491.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#492.src: Once again, you'll have a remote. Simply click in the right orders. However!
The Feathers Fly Part II#492.dst: Lần này bạn vẫn cầm điều khiển. Cứ nhấp đúng thứ tự. Nhưng mà!
The Feathers Fly Part II#492.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#493.src: Now, the machine requires a bit more... Dexterity.
The Feathers Fly Part II#493.dst: Giờ máy đòi hỏi thêm chút... Khéo léo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#493.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#494.src: If you're really quick, the machine will charge up real fast!
The Feathers Fly Part II#494.dst: Nếu bạn thật nhanh, máy sẽ nạp năng lượng cực nhanh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#494.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#495.src: If you're too slow however, it'd take a bit of time to charge up...
The Feathers Fly Part II#495.dst: Còn nếu chậm quá thì sẽ mất chút thời gian để nạp...
The Feathers Fly Part II#495.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#496.src: Time is still limited too. Don't worry, this is practice for the Council! Tell me once you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part II#496.dst: Thời gian vẫn có hạn. Yên tâm, đây là tập dượt cho Hội đồng! Sẵn sàng thì bảo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#496.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#503.src: You gotta admit, this has to be revolutionary!
The Feathers Fly Part II#503.dst: Phải công nhận, đây là cách mạng!
The Feathers Fly Part II#503.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#504.src: The corkian council... I hope they're nice. I really do. And you're coming!
The Feathers Fly Part II#504.dst: Hội đồng Corkian... Mong họ dễ chịu. Thật đấy. Và bạn đi cùng!
The Feathers Fly Part II#504.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#505.src: Hey, let's meet up near the receptionist. Say, want another lift? I can't get you inside the city, though!
The Feathers Fly Part II#505.dst: Này, gặp nhau gần chỗ lễ tân nhé. Đi nhờ nữa không? Nhưng tôi không đưa bạn vào thành được!
The Feathers Fly Part II#505.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#506.src: Cool, let's go! I still have to change back and wear the outfit you got me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#506.dst: Hay, đi thôi! Tôi còn phải thay lại bộ đồ bạn mua cho tôi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#506.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#507.src: I'll drop you off around the city outskirts. See ya!
The Feathers Fly Part II#507.dst: Tôi thả bạn ở vùng ven thành phố. Gặp sau!
The Feathers Fly Part II#507.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#509.src: Meet Ava to start the audience with the Corkian council at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#509.dst: Gặp Ava để bắt đầu buổi tiếp kiến Hội đồng Corkian tại [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#510.src: This is it, then. {u}, I'm... scared.
The Feathers Fly Part II#510.dst: Tới lúc rồi. {u}, tôi... sợ quá.
The Feathers Fly Part II#510.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#511.src: I guess it's normal to be stressed before an important event...
The Feathers Fly Part II#511.dst: Chắc căng thẳng trước chuyện quan trọng là bình thường...
The Feathers Fly Part II#511.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#512.src: Look, once we go in there, I'm really counting on you to go all in with the machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#512.dst: Nghe này, vào trong rồi, tôi trông cậy bạn dốc hết sức với cái máy.
The Feathers Fly Part II#512.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#513.src: I don't want to stress you out, but... Please know this is important to me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#513.dst: Không muốn làm bạn áp lực, nhưng... Chuyện này quan trọng với tôi lắm.
The Feathers Fly Part II#513.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#514.src: Alright, we should go now or else I'll just chicken out or somethin'.
The Feathers Fly Part II#514.dst: Được rồi, vào thôi, không thì tôi lại chùn bước mất.
The Feathers Fly Part II#514.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#515.src: Just... tell me once you're ready, I guess.
The Feathers Fly Part II#515.dst: Cứ... sẵn sàng thì bảo tôi nhé.
The Feathers Fly Part II#515.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#516.src: Stay close to me... Let's go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#516.dst: Đứng sát tôi nhé... Đi nào.
The Feathers Fly Part II#516.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#518.src: This is the right place... I'm sure it is...
The Feathers Fly Part II#518.dst: Đúng chỗ rồi mà... Chắc chắn đúng...
The Feathers Fly Part II#518.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#522.src: Nah, I saw him running around earlier. He's coming.
The Feathers Fly Part II#522.dst: Không, lúc nãy thấy cậu ta chạy quanh. Sắp tới.
The Feathers Fly Part II#522.speaker: Mei

The Feathers Fly Part II#524.src: Honestly, I wouldn't blame him if he decided to skip this one out.
The Feathers Fly Part II#524.dst: Thật lòng, cậu ta bỏ buổi này thì tôi cũng chẳng trách.
The Feathers Fly Part II#524.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#529.src: Sorry, sorry, I'm here! Am I late?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#529.dst: Xin lỗi, tới rồi! Tôi trễ à?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#529.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#530.src: We haven't started yet. You're fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#530.dst: Chưa bắt đầu đâu. Không sao.
The Feathers Fly Part II#530.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#532.src: Of course you'd know them. I'm not surprised.
The Feathers Fly Part II#532.dst: Tất nhiên cậu quen họ. Chả lạ.
The Feathers Fly Part II#532.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#533.src: How do you not?! They're the one who helped deal with the Factory!
The Feathers Fly Part II#533.dst: Sao lại không?! Người giúp xử vụ Nhà máy đấy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#533.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#534.src: ...So it's you. I somehow imagined you... More imposing. Huh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#534.dst: ...Vậy ra là cậu. Tôi cứ tưởng cậu... Oai hơn. Hừm.
The Feathers Fly Part II#534.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#537.src: Ava, was it? The handwriting's odd. Well, welcome to... the Council!
The Feathers Fly Part II#537.dst: Ava phải không? Chữ viết lạ thật. Chào mừng tới... Hội đồng!
The Feathers Fly Part II#537.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#539.src: *ahem* It's up to you, now. Do your thing. What do you have in store for us?
The Feathers Fly Part II#539.dst: *e hèm* Giờ tới lượt cô. Bắt đầu đi. Cô có gì cho chúng tôi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#539.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#540.src: H-Hello everyone. I'm a mechanic and I have something for you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#540.dst: X-xin chào mọi người. Tôi là thợ máy, có thứ này...
The Feathers Fly Part II#540.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#541.src: A mechanic? Which area? Maybe I have a friend wh-
The Feathers Fly Part II#541.dst: Thợ máy? Ngành nào? Có khi tôi có bạn-
The Feathers Fly Part II#541.speaker: Carl

The Feathers Fly Part II#542.src: Shut it Carl, let her talk.
The Feathers Fly Part II#542.dst: Im đi Carl, để cô ấy nói.
The Feathers Fly Part II#542.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#543.src: ...I've made a Growth Accelerator with help from .
The Feathers Fly Part II#543.dst: ...Tôi làm Máy Gia Tốc Sinh Trưởng nhờ .
The Feathers Fly Part II#543.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#544.src: It's- It- Uh, helps plants. Grow. Yeah.
The Feathers Fly Part II#544.dst: Nó- Nó- Ờ, giúp cây. Lớn. Ừ.
The Feathers Fly Part II#544.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#545.src: I'll just set it up super quickly!
The Feathers Fly Part II#545.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#561.src: I trust him. He's really been working hard as a new member.
The Feathers Fly Part II#561.dst: Tôi tin cậu ấy. Thành viên mới mà chăm lắm.
The Feathers Fly Part II#561.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#569.src: I can't believe you know them. They're out of your league, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#569.dst: Không tin cậu quen họ. Họ vượt tầm cậu, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#569.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#577.src: Y'know, you really don't look like the "inventor" type.
The Feathers Fly Part II#577.dst: Này, trông cô chả giống dân "phát minh".
The Feathers Fly Part II#577.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#578.src: I get that often, yeah. Green isn't really associated with money for me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#578.dst: Hay bị nói vậy lắm. Với tôi màu xanh lá đâu có nghĩa là tiền.
The Feathers Fly Part II#578.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#579.src: I enjoy nature and all, right? Well, I present to you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#579.dst: Tôi thích thiên nhiên, đúng không? Xin giới thiệu...
The Feathers Fly Part II#579.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#581.dst: Cây cối? Lạ đấy. Tôi tò mò.
The Feathers Fly Part II#581.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#582.src: As you should be! Let me quickly set the machine up.
The Feathers Fly Part II#582.dst: Phải thế chứ! Để tôi lắp máy nhanh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#582.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#598.src: I don't think he'll skip this one. You look cute, Ava! That's your name, right? Handwriting's a little iffy.
The Feathers Fly Part II#598.dst: Chắc cậu ta không bỏ buổi này. Trông cô dễ thương, Ava! Tên cô đúng không? Chữ hơi khó đọc.
The Feathers Fly Part II#598.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#606.src: And lo and behold, you know them. Of course.
The Feathers Fly Part II#606.dst: Và kìa, cậu quen họ. Tất nhiên.
The Feathers Fly Part II#606.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#611.src: Right, right. Ava! Welcome to... the Council!
The Feathers Fly Part II#611.dst: Phải, phải. Ava! Chào mừng tới... Hội đồng!
The Feathers Fly Part II#611.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#614.src: Hey, so... I'm here with to show you a little something!
The Feathers Fly Part II#614.dst: Chào, ờ... Tôi tới cùng để cho mọi người xem chút!
The Feathers Fly Part II#614.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#615.src: It's actually quite revolutionary! It's a Growth Accelerator!
The Feathers Fly Part II#615.dst: Khá là cách mạng đấy! Là Máy Gia Tốc Sinh Trưởng!
The Feathers Fly Part II#615.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#617.src: That piqued your interest, right? Well get ready!
The Feathers Fly Part II#617.dst: Tò mò rồi phải không? Vậy chuẩn bị nhé!
The Feathers Fly Part II#617.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#618.src: It's better outdoors, but I believe I can make it work here.
The Feathers Fly Part II#618.dst: Ngoài trời tốt hơn, nhưng chắc ở đây vẫn chạy được.
The Feathers Fly Part II#618.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#619.src: I'll set it up. Just sit back and watch!
The Feathers Fly Part II#619.dst: Tôi lắp đây. Cứ ngồi xem!
The Feathers Fly Part II#619.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#651.dst: *tách* XIN CHÀO MỌI NG- *tách* Nhầm nút.
The Feathers Fly Part II#651.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#652.src: I see you're familiar with your toy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#652.dst: Rành đồ chơi của mình ghê!
The Feathers Fly Part II#652.speaker: Mei

The Feathers Fly Part II#653.src: Hey, look, I've only had it for a few- Nevermind. That's not what I'm here for.
The Feathers Fly Part II#653.dst: Này, tôi mới có nó được vài- Thôi. Tôi tới không vì chuyện đó.
The Feathers Fly Part II#653.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#654.src: Wait, you brought such an armour and that's not what you're showcasing?
The Feathers Fly Part II#654.dst: Khoan, mang bộ giáp cỡ đó mà không định khoe nó à?
The Feathers Fly Part II#654.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#655.src: You certainly caught our attention. Go on.
The Feathers Fly Part II#655.dst: Cô gây chú ý thật đấy. Tiếp đi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#655.speaker: Clomius

The Feathers Fly Part II#656.src: Show the Corkians the Growth Accelerator with Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#656.dst: Cùng Ava trình diễn Máy Gia Tốc Sinh Trưởng tại [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#657.src: This is really it, then. No backing down now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#657.dst: Thật sự tới lúc rồi. Không lùi được nữa.
The Feathers Fly Part II#657.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#658.src: I'll just try not to replicate my mistake back then with the Avos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#658.dst: Tôi chỉ mong không lặp lại sai lầm hồi trước với Avos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#658.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#659.src: It's time to show them. I don't really have anything extra to tell you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#659.dst: Tới lúc cho họ xem rồi. Tôi chẳng còn gì để nói thêm.
The Feathers Fly Part II#659.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#660.src: It's as the president just said, {u}. Do your thing.
The Feathers Fly Part II#660.dst: Như tổng thống vừa nói, {u}. Làm đi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#660.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#663.src: You certainly seem to have trained, young lady. I respect that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#663.dst: Cô hẳn đã luyện tập, cô gái. Tôi trân trọng điều đó.
The Feathers Fly Part II#663.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#664.src: This almost reminds me of, uuuh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#664.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#665.src: Hold on, it's on the tip of my tongue...
The Feathers Fly Part II#665.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#666.dst: À phải, phép Avos! Đúng chứ??
The Feathers Fly Part II#666.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#668.src: I do believe this has potential. Let us see more of it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#668.dst: Tôi tin thứ này có tiềm năng. Xem tiếp nào.
The Feathers Fly Part II#668.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#672.src: I like the sounds, at least!
The Feathers Fly Part II#672.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#673.src: Wow, the machine's really warmed up this time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#673.dst: Chà, lần này máy nóng máy thật.
The Feathers Fly Part II#673.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#674.src: Looks like you'll get less penalties if you press the wrong button now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#674.dst: Giờ có vẻ bấm nhầm nút sẽ bị phạt ít hơn.
The Feathers Fly Part II#674.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#675.dst: Ồ, linh kiện đó, nó là-
The Feathers Fly Part II#675.speaker: Carl

The Feathers Fly Part II#678.src: This seems very propitious. Go on.
The Feathers Fly Part II#678.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#681.src: So {u} knows how to handle machines too? Nifty!
The Feathers Fly Part II#681.dst: {u} cũng biết điều khiển máy à? Hay đấy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#681.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#682.src: You guys aren't ready for this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#682.dst: Các vị chưa sẵn sàng đâu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#682.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#765.src: Watch Ava show her Growth Accelerator
The Feathers Fly Part II#765.dst: Xem Ava trình diễn Máy Gia Tốc

The Feathers Fly Part II#766.src: Oh my... Oh my grook. This is... Wow...
The Feathers Fly Part II#766.dst: Ôi... Ôi Grook ơi. Thật là... Chà...
The Feathers Fly Part II#766.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#767.src: It's the real deal. That girl managed to instantly overgrow a flower.
The Feathers Fly Part II#767.dst: Hàng thật đấy. Cô bé làm một bông hoa lớn vọt tức thì.
The Feathers Fly Part II#767.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#768.src: ...Don't look at us like that, I'm as surprised as you are.
The Feathers Fly Part II#768.dst: ...Đừng nhìn tôi thế, tôi cũng bất ngờ như mọi người.
The Feathers Fly Part II#768.speaker: Mei

The Feathers Fly Part II#769.src: Well, Ava... You've won me over. I'm impressed!
The Feathers Fly Part II#769.dst: Chà, Ava... Cô thuyết phục tôi rồi. Ấn tượng!
The Feathers Fly Part II#769.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#770.src: Hey, you alright? It's not often mechanics impress us. Good job.
The Feathers Fly Part II#770.dst: Này, ổn chứ? Hiếm khi thợ máy làm chúng tôi ấn tượng. Giỏi lắm.
The Feathers Fly Part II#770.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#771.src: This is all really nice, but... How does this work?
The Feathers Fly Part II#771.dst: Hay thật đấy, nhưng... Nó hoạt động sao?
The Feathers Fly Part II#771.speaker: Carl

The Feathers Fly Part II#772.src: Shut it, Carl! No one c- Wait. Actually...
The Feathers Fly Part II#772.dst: Im đi Carl! Chả ai qu- Khoan. Thật ra...
The Feathers Fly Part II#772.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#773.src: No one in Corkus ever made anything like this. Do you have anything to tell us, or show?
The Feathers Fly Part II#773.dst: Chưa ai ở Corkus làm được thứ thế này. Cô có gì muốn nói, hay cho xem không?
The Feathers Fly Part II#773.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#776.src: I... How do I put this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#776.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#777.src: I'm not exactly like you guys.
The Feathers Fly Part II#777.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#780.src: What kind of prank is this?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#780.speaker: Carl

The Feathers Fly Part II#785.src: What should we do what should we-
The Feathers Fly Part II#785.speaker: Mei

The Feathers Fly Part II#793.src: Let's calm down and start ag-
The Feathers Fly Part II#793.dst: Bình tĩnh rồi bắt đầu l-
The Feathers Fly Part II#793.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#795.src: Hmpf? Just take her on the spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#795.dst: Hừm? Bắt cô ta ngay đi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#795.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#796.src: We wouldn't have known with such an outfit.
The Feathers Fly Part II#796.dst: Ăn mặc vậy thì ai mà biết.
The Feathers Fly Part II#796.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#797.src: There's only one thing I want to know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#797.dst: Tôi chỉ muốn biết một điều.
The Feathers Fly Part II#797.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#798.src: Did you know, or did she trick you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#798.dst: Cậu biết, hay cô ta lừa cậu?
The Feathers Fly Part II#798.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#799.src: I swear {u} didn't know! Believe me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#799.dst: Tôi thề {u} không biết! Tin tôi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#799.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#800.src: Sure, and then what? What did you hope to accomplish?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#800.dst: Ừ, rồi sao? Cô mong đạt được gì?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#800.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#801.src: I'm unsure if I should be impressed, distressed or enraged. So I think I'll just be all three! Ava, congratulations.
The Feathers Fly Part II#801.dst: Tôi không biết nên ấn tượng, lo lắng hay giận dữ. Nên chắc cả ba luôn vậy! Ava, chúc mừng.
The Feathers Fly Part II#801.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#802.src: But... Why... I don't get it. I don't get the Avos. I don't get humans...
The Feathers Fly Part II#802.dst: Nhưng... Sao... Tôi không hiểu. Không hiểu Avos. Không hiểu con người...
The Feathers Fly Part II#802.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#803.src: What's so wrong about me? Why shouldn't I do electromagic? Why??
The Feathers Fly Part II#803.dst: Tôi có gì sai? Sao tôi không được dùng điện ma thuật? Tại sao??
The Feathers Fly Part II#803.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#804.src: Oh, darling. You impress then enrage me, and now you want me to pity you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#804.dst: Ôi cưng. Cô làm tôi ấn tượng rồi giận, giờ lại muốn tôi thương hại.
The Feathers Fly Part II#804.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#805.src: You know, your kind has always been...
The Feathers Fly Part II#805.dst: Biết không, giống loài cô luôn...
The Feathers Fly Part II#805.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#806.src: So archaic. Always with their spirituality, their flora, their beliefs, their traditions...
The Feathers Fly Part II#806.dst: Thật cổ hủ. Lúc nào cũng tâm linh, cây cỏ, đức tin, truyền thống...
The Feathers Fly Part II#806.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#807.src: And you, you're fiddling not only with nature, but also with OUR things.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.dst: Còn cô, cô không chỉ vọc thiên nhiên mà cả đồ của CHÚNG TÔI.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#808.src: Somehow, you're able to control electromagic? I guess it's not exclusive to humans, then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.dst: Cô điều khiển được điện ma thuật? Vậy chắc nó không chỉ của con người.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#809.src: Even then, I see no reason as to why we should let you interact with us. You shouldn't be here.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.dst: Dù vậy, tôi chẳng thấy lý do gì để cô qua lại với chúng tôi. Cô không nên ở đây.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#810.src: I think... I finally get it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#810.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#811.src: I do, really. The truth is...
The Feathers Fly Part II#811.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#814.src: I come up to you with an incredible breakthrough, and you can't even see past my feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part II#814.dst: Tôi mang tới đột phá phi thường, mà các người chẳng nhìn qua nổi bộ lông của tôi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#814.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#815.src: Alright, I've heard enough. That's it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#815.dst: Được rồi, nghe đủ rồi. Thôi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#815.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#817.src: Don't you dare touch- Gah! I'll show you. I'll show everyone what you're missing out on!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.dst: Đừng hòng chạm- Á! Để tôi cho xem. Cho cả thế giới thấy các người bỏ lỡ gì!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#818.src: What just... Everyone! Dismissed! What is that girl doing?! I'll go after her! Nodise, Maxie, you go and help Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.dst: Chuyện gì... Mọi người! Giải tán! Con bé làm gì vậy?! Tôi đuổi theo! Nodise, Maxie, đi giúp Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#823.src: You're crying?! Aw... There, there. It's alright, you made it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.dst: Cậu khóc à?! Ôi... Nào, nào. Không sao, cậu làm được rồi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#902.src: God, I hate to say it, but her mask was flawless.
The Feathers Fly Part II#902.dst: Trời, ghét phải nói, nhưng mặt nạ cô ta hoàn hảo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#902.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#903.src: Flawless?! More like flawful! This was so obvious!
The Feathers Fly Part II#903.dst: Hoàn hảo?! Hoàn hỏng thì có! Lộ liễu thế cơ mà!
The Feathers Fly Part II#903.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#904.src: And WHY didn't you say so??
The Feathers Fly Part II#904.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#905.src: I- uh, y'know, didn't want to assume...
The Feathers Fly Part II#905.dst: Tôi- ờ, kiểu, không muốn đoán bừa...
The Feathers Fly Part II#905.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#906.src: Urgh. Look, there's only one think I want to know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#906.dst: Hừ. Nghe này, tôi chỉ muốn biết một điều.
The Feathers Fly Part II#906.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#907.src: ... Did you know, or did she trick you? Be very careful about what you're about to say.
The Feathers Fly Part II#907.dst: ... Cậu biết, hay cô ta lừa cậu? Cẩn thận lời sắp nói đấy.
The Feathers Fly Part II#907.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#932.src: I didn't really doubt you with your armour. We have a few questions though!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.dst: Với bộ giáp đó tôi không nghi cậu mấy. Nhưng có vài câu hỏi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#979.src: Huh, that armour's actually powerful. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll show everyone what I'm really capable of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.dst: Chà, bộ giáp đó mạnh thật. Giờ xin phép, tôi sẽ cho mọi người thấy tôi làm được gì.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#982.src: Well... Mo'in, {u}. I was thinking about catching up with you and all after the audience, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.dst: Chà... Mo'in, {u}. Tôi định sau buổi tiếp kiến sẽ hàn huyên với bạn, nhưng...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#983.src: I guess we don't really have time for that now, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.dst: Chắc giờ chẳng có thời gian cho chuyện đó nhỉ?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#984.src: Wow, Maxie, great time management you got there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.dst: Chà Maxie, quản lý thời gian giỏi ghê!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#985.src: Sybil... This is no time to quarrel.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.dst: Sybil... Không phải lúc cãi nhau.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#986.src: Have you seen what just happened? I'm sure even now he'll keep defending the Avos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.dst: Thấy chuyện vừa rồi chưa? Tôi chắc tới giờ cậu ta vẫn sẽ bênh Avos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#987.src: Look, there's no time right now. I think {u} and I should go and help.
The Feathers Fly Part II#987.dst: Nghe này, giờ không có thời gian. Tôi nghĩ tôi với {u} nên đi giúp.
The Feathers Fly Part II#987.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#988.src: Nodise... You probably should stay here too. We-
The Feathers Fly Part II#988.dst: Nodise... Có lẽ anh cũng nên ở lại đây. Bọn-
The Feathers Fly Part II#988.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#989.src: Wha-What's happening?! Oh dear, I'll just run there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#989.dst: C-chuyện gì vậy?! Trời ạ, tôi chạy tới đó đây!
The Feathers Fly Part II#989.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#990.src: Prevent Ava from making a mistake at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#990.dst: Ngăn Ava phạm sai lầm tại [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#991.src: Well look who decided to show up. I thought you would've fled by now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.dst: Xem ai tới kìa. Tôi tưởng giờ này cậu chuồn mất rồi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#992.src: So what? Here to fix your mistakes? Help your insane bird friend?
The Feathers Fly Part II#992.dst: Sao? Tới sửa sai à? Giúp con bạn chim điên của cậu?
The Feathers Fly Part II#992.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#993.src: For such a plant to grow in a few seconds... I can't believe this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#993.dst: Một cái cây cỡ này mọc lên trong vài giây... Không tin nổi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#993.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#994.src: Maxie's your friend, right? Well he's in there already. You should go, too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#994.dst: Maxie là bạn cậu, đúng không? Cậu ấy vào trong rồi. Cậu cũng nên đi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#994.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#995.src: I think you gotta reach the top to take care of this. Maybe multiple times.
The Feathers Fly Part II#995.dst: Chắc phải lên tới đỉnh mới xử lý được. Có khi phải nhiều lần.
The Feathers Fly Part II#995.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#998.src: {u}!! I'm sure Efena told you already, no time to talk!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.dst: {u}!! Chắc Efena nói rồi, không có thời gian nói đâu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#999.src: Apparently, there's something up there! Try to reach the top! There are strange plants around, see if that helps!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.dst: Nghe nói trên kia có gì đó! Cố lên tới đỉnh! Quanh đây có cây lạ, thử xem có giúp được không!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.src: ...You're here. Here to fix my own mistakes, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.dst: ...Bạn tới rồi. Tới sửa sai cho tôi, nhỉ?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.src: And then, here to take me, I suppose. Right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.dst: Rồi tới bắt tôi, chắc vậy. Đúng không?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.src: Y'know, I noticed you always were one to follow orders. Well, what you're lookin' for is on top of the plant.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.dst: Biết không, tôi để ý bạn luôn làm theo lệnh. Thứ bạn tìm ở trên đỉnh cái cây.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.src: I... I'm not gonna fight back. There's no point. Just... Just go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.dst: Tôi... Tôi không chống lại đâu. Vô ích. Cứ... Cứ đi đi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.src: Woah! You did something! You should try that again!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.dst: Ồ! Bạn làm được gì đó rồi! Thử lại lần nữa đi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.src: I - I really didn't want this. I wanted to help people, {u}! Not... not...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.dst: T-tôi thật sự không muốn thế này. Tôi muốn giúp mọi người, {u}! Không...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.src: I sure have impressed everyone. So I guess not all's lost, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.dst: Tôi làm ai cũng ấn tượng rồi. Vậy chưa mất hết, nhỉ?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.src: I'll be the talk of an entire nation!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.dst: Tôi sẽ thành chuyện cả nước bàn tán!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.src: Gosh, I really am going crazy aren't I?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.dst: Trời ơi, tôi điên thật rồi phải không?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.src: I just... I don't know what to do... I reached rock bottom...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.dst: Tôi chỉ... Tôi không biết phải làm gì... Tôi chạm đáy rồi...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.src: I screwed up with my people, then with the humans, then...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.dst: Tôi làm hỏng với đồng tộc, rồi với con người, rồi...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1012.dst: {u}! Ava ở trên đó, phải không?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1012.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.src: Could you tell her something for me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.dst: Nhắn giùm tôi một câu được không?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.src: Tell her that... I'm not that mad.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.dst: Bảo cô ấy... tôi không giận lắm.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.src: This... While destructive, it's impressive, and...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.dst: Cái này... Phá hoại thật, nhưng ấn tượng, và...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.src: Whatever, just tell her! People will think I lost my mind, it's fine!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.dst: Thôi kệ, cứ nói giùm! Người ta sẽ tưởng tôi mất trí, kệ!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.src: I'd like to talk to her. I assume she'll just flee, but... You should try!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.dst: Tôi muốn nói chuyện với cô ấy. Chắc cô ấy sẽ chạy, nhưng... Thử xem!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.src: ...What? Do you have anythin' to tell me before I leave?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.dst: ...Gì? Có gì muốn nói trước khi tôi đi không?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.src: Huh?! The president herself isn't too mad at me? What??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.dst: Hả?! Chính tổng thống không giận tôi lắm? Gì cơ??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.src: Are you trying to make me get down and get arrested? You know I... I can't believe you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.dst: Bạn định dụ tôi xuống để bị bắt à? Bạn biết tôi... Không ngờ bạn...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.src: I want to, but... Have you seen how she was during the audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.dst: Tôi muốn, nhưng... Thấy bà ta lúc tiếp kiến thế nào chưa?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.src: I can't trust you, {u}. There's no way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.dst: Tôi không tin bạn, {u}. Không đời nào.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.src: I regret this... I shouldn't have acted this way, this wasn't supposed to happen, I...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.dst: Tôi hối hận... Lẽ ra không nên làm vậy, chuyện này không nên xảy ra, tôi...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.src: I can't stay, {u}. The president's one thing, but the others...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.dst: Tôi phải đi, {u}. Tổng thống thì khác, nhưng mấy người kia...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.src: No point fighting back, even though I could totally manage. I feel bad for that other girl now. Go, then... Stop my machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.dst: Chống lại cũng vô ích, dù tôi thừa sức. Giờ thấy tội cô gái kia. Đi đi... Dừng máy của tôi lại.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1106.dst: Tìm hiểu chuyện gì đã xảy ra

The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.src: Hmpf. Did {u} take that thing down?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.dst: Hừm. {u} hạ thứ đó rồi à?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.src: Oh she better be around here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.dst: Cô ta liệu mà ở quanh đây!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.src: Wait, under the rubble, I see something!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.dst: Khoan, dưới đống đổ nát có gì đó!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.src: Look, I'll give you a mission. Find Ava with {u}, and tell her this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.dst: Nghe này, tôi giao cậu nhiệm vụ. Cùng {u} tìm Ava, và nói với cô ấy...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1117.dst: {u}?! Bạn à? Tôi ở dưới này!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1117.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.src: Mo'in, {u}! You're fine! I'm so glad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.dst: Mo'in, {u}! Bạn ổn rồi! Mừng quá!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.src: You're something of a hero, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.dst: Bạn đúng là anh hùng đấy, biết chứ?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.src: That was some really nice job back there! But now...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.dst: Vụ vừa rồi làm tốt lắm! Nhưng giờ...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.src: Well, the town's fine, but... I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.dst: Thị trấn ổn rồi, nhưng... Tôi được giao đi tìm Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.src: From what I've gathered, you worked with her and know where to go, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.dst: Theo tôi biết thì bạn từng làm với cô ấy và biết đi đâu, đúng không?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.src: Oh, you told Ava about Efena? And she... she fled. Right. Well, I'm not surprised!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.dst: Ồ, bạn kể với Ava về Efena à? Rồi cô ấy... bỏ chạy. Ừ. Chả lạ!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.src: Trust me, we want to help that poor Avo. Let's just find her, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.dst: Tin tôi, bọn tôi muốn giúp cô Avo tội nghiệp đó. Tìm cô ấy đã, nhé?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.src: Tell me whenever you're ready, and we'll go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.dst: Khi nào sẵn sàng thì bảo, mình đi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1127.dst: ...Đó à? *thở dài* Mong cô ấy ở đó.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1127.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1128.src: Find Ava at the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.src: The Avos chief did mention her once, but this place is crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.dst: Tù trưởng Avos từng nhắc tới cô ấy, mà chỗ này điên thật!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.src: You... I assume you're here to take me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.dst: Các người... Chắc tới bắt tôi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.src: Go ahead, then. Do it. I don't have anything to lose anymore. I've already lost everything.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.dst: Cứ làm đi. Làm đi. Tôi chẳng còn gì để mất. Tôi mất hết rồi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.src: I don't want your pity. I have no one. You're making this harder for yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.dst: Tôi không cần thương hại. Tôi chẳng còn ai. Anh chỉ tự làm khó mình.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.src: The president didn't sentence you to death or anything... Quite the opposite, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.dst: Tổng thống đâu có xử tử cô hay gì... Thật ra là ngược lại.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.src: What do you mean? Why should I trust you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.dst: Ý anh là sao? Sao tôi phải tin anh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1138.src: Don't bother, Maxie. I'll explain myself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1138.dst: Thôi, Maxie. Để tôi tự giải thích.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.src: Nice place. I can clearly see how our culture got to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.dst: Chỗ đẹp đấy. Thấy rõ văn hóa của bọn tôi ngấm vào cô.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.src: So you're here. Are you... Forgiving me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.dst: Bà tới rồi. Bà... tha thứ cho tôi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.src: Oh, "forgive" is a really strong word, Ava. Look.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.dst: Ôi, "tha thứ" là từ nặng lắm, Ava. Nghe này.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.src: I do believe we can all learn a thing or two about this. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.dst: Tôi tin ai cũng học được đôi điều từ chuyện này. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.src: You broke the law, and as such, you're not allowed in town. Ya understand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.dst: Cô đã phạm luật, nên cô không được vào thị trấn. Hiểu chứ?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.src: First the Avos, then you, huh. So it's come full circle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.dst: Đầu tiên Avos, giờ tới các người. Vậy là đủ một vòng.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.src: Look, that machine of yours is impressive. I'm not lying. You're talented.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.dst: Nghe này, cái máy của cô ấn tượng lắm. Không đùa. Cô có tài.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.src: But you've definitely made quite the mistake. I did too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.dst: Nhưng cô mắc sai lầm lớn rồi. Tôi cũng vậy.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.src: I guess you and I really learnt what "acting in the heat of the moment" means, huh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.dst: Chắc cô và tôi đều đã hiểu "hành động lúc nóng giận" là gì, nhỉ.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.src: I have some sort of... Compromise. For us. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.dst: Tôi có một kiểu... Thỏa hiệp. Cho cả hai. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.src: Yeah, I'm... interested in working with you. Learning from you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.dst: Ừ, tôi... muốn làm việc với cô. Học hỏi từ cô.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.src: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.dst: Rõ là cô giỏi Điện ma thuật hơn tôi, nên...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.src: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.dst: Tôi sẵn sàng lo cho cô những gì cần. Thỉnh thoảng giúp một tay.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.src: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.dst: Cô cô độc lâu quá rồi, Ava. Tôi cho cô mượn Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.src: Hey, don't say it like that!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.src: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.dst: *cười khúc khích* Đùa thôi. Cả Hội đồng chưa biết đâu.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.src: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.dst: Họ sẽ không thích, nhưng để tôi lo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.src: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.dst: Cô biết tôi không thể giết cô. Tưởng tượng Avos sẽ phản ứng sao? Dù cô bị trục xuất...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.src: But I don't want to either. As for you, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.dst: Nhưng tôi cũng không muốn. Còn cậu, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.src: I'll give you some stuff. I can't imagine how things would've gone if it weren't for you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.dst: Tôi tặng cậu vài thứ. Không có cậu thì chẳng biết mọi chuyện sẽ ra sao.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.src: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.dst: Giờ cô bị mọi người trục xuất, Ava. Tôi biết đó không phải kết đẹp.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.src: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.dst: Nhưng thế thì dễ quá, nhỉ?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.src: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.dst: Có thể sau này cô sẽ có kết đẹp. Nhưng tạm thời không còn cô độc là được rồi, nhỉ?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.dst: Tạm biệt, Ava. Ai biết, có khi tôi ghé chơi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.src: ...{u}? If you stop by the Workshop later, I'll set up something for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.dst: ...{u}? Nếu sau này ghé Xưởng, tôi cũng chuẩn bị gì đó cho bạn.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1164.dst: Tạm biệt. Cảm ơn. Vì tất cả.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1164.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes. After all, you're very stylish!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.dst: Tạm biệt, Ava. Ai biết, có khi tôi ghé chơi. Dù sao cô cũng sành điệu lắm!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, I might stop by sometimes. Maybe you'll have figured out that armour of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.dst: Tạm biệt, Ava. Ai biết, có khi tôi ghé chơi. Biết đâu lúc đó cô đã hiểu bộ giáp đó.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.src: Please contact Cerid for more information about this model.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.dst: Vui lòng liên hệ Cerid để biết thêm về mẫu này.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.src: If you have any questions, know that I am definitely not the right machine to ask.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.dst: Nếu có câu hỏi, xin biết rằng tôi chắc chắn không phải cỗ máy nên hỏi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.src: Hey, it's alright. We'll be fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.dst: Này, không sao đâu. Sẽ ổn thôi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.dst: Biết không, Xưởng của cô đẹp hơn tôi tưởng nhiều.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.dst: {u}, cảm ơn đã giúp. Bạn giới thiệu cho tôi một tài năng thật!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.dst: Tin tôi, tôi biết bị từ chối là thế nào. Chắc ai cũng biết, theo cách riêng.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.dst: Efena... Chắc chắn dễ chịu hơn Tù trưởng...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.dst: Tất cả chuyện này... Khó tin quá.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.dst: {u}, khi quay lại đây, bạn có thể lấy vài món đồ chơi của tôi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.src: We don't have that much time you know!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.dst: Bọn mình không có nhiều thời gian đâu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.src: Looks like there's an outfit ready right here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.dst: Hình như ngay đây có bộ đồ sẵn!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.src: You can give it to Ava, or you can look around the other rooms for more options.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.dst: Bạn có thể đưa nó cho Ava, hoặc xem các phòng khác để có lựa chọn khác.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.src: There's some clothes here. They're dirty though.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.dst: Ở đây có quần áo. Nhưng bẩn.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.src: There must be a way to wash those somewhere nearby.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.dst: Chắc quanh đây có chỗ giặt chúng.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1364.dst: Bạn bắt đầu giặt quần áo...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.src: Shoot, I think someone's coming!! Come back!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.dst: Chết, hình như có người tới!! Quay lại!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1368.src: You take a look inside the drawer...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1368.dst: Bạn nhìn vào trong ngăn kéo...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.src: Lucky! There's a Mechanic Outfit in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.dst: May quá! Có bộ Đồ thợ máy trong đó.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.src: You pick up a particularly tasty-looking bone.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.dst: Bạn nhặt một khúc xương trông ngon lạ.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.src: There's some sort of armour in that chest. It looks flashy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.dst: Trong rương có bộ giáp gì đó. Trông lòe loẹt!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.src: It's... Quite hard to move around with that outfit, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.dst: Mặc bộ đó... khá khó cử động, thật đấy.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.src: ...Is that someone crying over there? Eh, I'm not sure my social skills can handle that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.dst: ...Ai đang khóc đằng kia à? Ơ, tôi không chắc kỹ năng giao tiếp của tôi kham nổi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.src: Woah there, what's that letter? You actually got an invitation?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.dst: Ồ, lá thư gì thế? Bạn lấy được thư mời thật à?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.src: I... Wow. Well I'm impressed! I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.dst: Tôi... Chà. Ấn tượng đấy! Thật đó!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.src: Did we even need a letter? That armour probably would've done the trick!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.dst: Có cần thư không ta? Bộ giáp đó chắc cũng đủ rồi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.src: Well... If you want me to follow you, tell me. I've heard 'bout a receptionist in the far end of the castle, so maybe we should go there?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.dst: Chà... Muốn tôi đi theo thì bảo nhé. Nghe nói có cô lễ tân ở cuối lâu đài, hay ta tới đó?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.src: I heard there was a dealer around here but... We have the letter, so let's just keep goin'.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.dst: Nghe nói quanh đây có gã buôn nhưng... Ta có thư rồi, cứ đi tiếp thôi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.src: Well, no matter! I'll just... See when the council's available and book a meeting...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.dst: Thôi, sao cũng được! Để tôi... xem khi nào Hội đồng rảnh rồi xếp lịch...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.src: How peculiar. I wonder how they got that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.dst: Lạ thật. Không biết sao họ có được...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.src: Hey! I saw you run towards the castle. What did you do?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.dst: Này! Thấy bạn chạy về phía lâu đài. Bạn làm gì vậy?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.src: ...Wait, what? You went to the receptionist alone, just like that?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.dst: ...Khoan, gì cơ? Bạn tự đi gặp lễ tân một mình, thế thôi à?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.src: An audience is booked, and you didn't even give me the chance to show my cool armour!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.dst: Đã xếp được tiếp kiến, mà bạn chả cho tôi cơ hội khoe bộ giáp ngầu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.src: I... I'm really grateful. What a relief. I did some tweaking regarding the machine, so you should come and test with me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.dst: Tôi... Tôi thật sự biết ơn. Nhẹ cả người. Tôi đã chỉnh máy chút, bạn tới thử cùng tôi nhé!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.src: As I've said, this is only practice, don't worry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.dst: Như đã nói, chỉ là tập dượt, đừng lo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.src: Just tell me when you're up for another round!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.dst: Khi nào muốn làm lượt nữa thì bảo nhé!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.src: You probably should wait for Ava first.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.dst: Có lẽ bạn nên đợi Ava trước.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.src: My guts are telling me this one's gonna be impressive. I hope he's there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.dst: Linh cảm bảo tôi vụ này sẽ ấn tượng đây. Mong cậu ta có mặt.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.src: Looks like she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.dst: Có vẻ cô ấy đợi bạn ra hiệu.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1404.dst: Đến tôi cũng bị cuốn vào!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1404.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.src: I still can't believe this isn't about your armour.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.dst: Vẫn không tin vụ này không phải về bộ giáp.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.src: No worries... Well, I'm worrying, but that doesn't mean you have to.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.dst: Đừng lo... Tôi thì lo, nhưng bạn không cần phải lo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.src: Alright guys, don't worry... We got this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.dst: Được rồi mọi người, đừng lo... Ổn mà.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.src: I'll just... wait for your signal, {u}.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.dst: Tôi sẽ... đợi bạn ra hiệu, {u}.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.src: Hmpf. I certainly am curious now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.dst: Hừm. Giờ tôi tò mò thật.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.src: She's glancing at you. Maybe she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.dst: Cô ấy liếc nhìn bạn. Có lẽ đang đợi bạn ra hiệu.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.src: EVERYONE! STOP! {u}, I want you to come here and answer something, immediately.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.dst: TẤT CẢ! DỪNG LẠI! {u}, lại đây trả lời tôi một câu, ngay.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.src: You take a deep breath, and-
The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.dst: Bạn hít một hơi sâu, và-
The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.src: Looks like Maxie wants to speak to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.dst: Có vẻ Maxie muốn nói chuyện với bạn.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.src: You're- *cough* so good at handling... priorities, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.dst: Cậu- *khụ* giỏi sắp xếp... ưu tiên ghê, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.src: Save your energy for later, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.dst: Để dành sức cho sau, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.src: Even after... Even after this, I'm sure *cough* he'll keep defending them...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.dst: Kể cả sau... Kể cả sau vụ này, chắc chắn *khụ* cậu ta vẫn bênh họ...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1419.dst: Bên ngoài có tiếng ầm ầm.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.src: You've been... *cough* tricked by... Quite the individual, {u}. You better redeem yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.dst: Cậu đã bị... *khụ* lừa bởi... một kẻ ghê gớm, {u}. Liệu mà chuộc lỗi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.src: Efena doesn't seem very pleased to see you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.dst: Efena có vẻ chẳng vui khi gặp bạn.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.src: No time to talk, {u}! Just go! There must be a core to hit at the top!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.dst: Không có thời gian nói, {u}! Đi đi! Trên đỉnh chắc có lõi để đánh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.src: Well, besides the citizens being afraid... I'd say the town's fine. However! I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.dst: Ngoài chuyện dân chúng sợ hãi... Tôi nghĩ thị trấn ổn. Nhưng mà! Tôi được giao đi tìm Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.src: Somehow... Efena ended up liking her.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.dst: Chả hiểu sao... Efena lại quý cô ấy.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.src: I'm reading, but I'll be done soon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.dst: Đang đọc, nhưng sắp xong rồi!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.src: Y-you!! I- oh no... I'm... It's over..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.dst: B-bạn!! Tôi- ôi không... Hết rồi..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.src: Hey, hey, calm down! I'm here to actually help you... in a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.dst: Này, bình tĩnh! Tôi tới để giúp cô thật mà... theo cách nào đó.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.speaker: Efena

The Hero of Gavel#000.src: Find out what's happening in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#000.dst: Tìm hiểu chuyện gì xảy ra ở trung tâm {p} tại [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#001.src: Hmm.. I might have just enough for one tier {~}... Why are you standing there?
The Hero of Gavel#001.dst: Hừm.. Chắc đủ tiền cho một món bậc {~}... Sao cậu đứng đó?
The Hero of Gavel#001.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#002.src: What all these people are here for? Don't tell me you don't know about the Siegfried contest.
The Hero of Gavel#002.dst: Đám đông này tới làm gì á? Đừng nói cậu không biết cuộc thi Siegfried nhé.
The Hero of Gavel#002.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#003.src: Are you SERIOUS?! It's the biggest thing happening since the last contest last month!
The Hero of Gavel#003.dst: Cậu NÓI THẬT à?! Đó là sự kiện lớn nhất kể từ cuộc thi tháng trước!
The Hero of Gavel#003.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#004.src: Whoever wins the big scavenger hunt gets to go on an adventure with Siegfried himself.
The Hero of Gavel#004.dst: Ai thắng cuộc săn kho báu lớn sẽ được phiêu lưu cùng chính Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#004.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#005.src: This year, I think I even have a good chance to win!
The Hero of Gavel#005.dst: Năm nay tôi nghĩ mình còn có cơ hội thắng!
The Hero of Gavel#005.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#006.src: Huh? Oh, you want this ticket? No way, this one's mine. Go get your own at that little shop.
The Hero of Gavel#006.dst: Hả? Ồ, muốn vé này à? Không đời nào, của tôi. Ra cửa hàng nhỏ kia mà mua.
The Hero of Gavel#006.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#007.src: Hey, that's the mug I dropped!
The Hero of Gavel#007.dst: Này, cốc tôi làm rơi mà!
The Hero of Gavel#007.speaker: Siegfried Fan 1

The Hero of Gavel#011.src: How can I win an adventure now?
The Hero of Gavel#011.speaker: Siegfried Fan 2

The Hero of Gavel#012.src: Get a Siegfried Scavenger Hunt ticket in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#012.dst: Lấy vé Săn kho báu Siegfried ở trung tâm {p} tại [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#013.src: Tickets for sale! You! Would you like to join the great Siegfried Scavenger Hunt?
The Hero of Gavel#013.dst: Bán vé đây! Cậu kia! Muốn tham gia Cuộc săn kho báu Siegfried không?
The Hero of Gavel#013.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#014.src: Entry is completely free, and if you win, you'll get to adventure with Siegfried himself!
The Hero of Gavel#014.dst: Tham gia hoàn toàn miễn phí, thắng thì được phiêu lưu cùng chính Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#014.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#015.src: You're interested? Great! Here, it's all quite simple.
The Hero of Gavel#015.dst: Hứng thú à? Tuyệt! Đây, đơn giản lắm.
The Hero of Gavel#015.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#016.src: The ticket shows what items you need to find. It's split into three tiers.
The Hero of Gavel#016.dst: Vé ghi những món cần tìm. Chia làm ba bậc.
The Hero of Gavel#016.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#017.src: The first two, they're for the common folk. But if you REALLY want to win, you need a tier {~} item.
The Hero of Gavel#017.dst: Hai bậc đầu dành cho dân thường. Nhưng nếu THẬT SỰ muốn thắng, cần món bậc {~}.
The Hero of Gavel#017.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#018.src: Heh, you can even bring all three and you're practically guaranteed to win!
The Hero of Gavel#018.dst: Hê, mang cả ba thì gần như chắc thắng!
The Hero of Gavel#018.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#019.src: Here, take the ticket. Come back with your items and you'll be entered into the draw.
The Hero of Gavel#019.dst: Đây, cầm vé. Mang đồ về đây là được vào bốc thăm.
The Hero of Gavel#019.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#020.src: Bring all three limited Siegfried Collection items to the merchant in {p} Center at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#020.dst: Mang cả ba món Bộ sưu tập Siegfried giới hạn tới thương nhân ở trung tâm {p} tại [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#021.src: You’re back! Let me see your items.
The Hero of Gavel#021.dst: Về rồi! Cho xem đồ nào.
The Hero of Gavel#021.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#022.src: This… Wow, all of them? Let me take a look at these…
The Hero of Gavel#022.dst: Cái này… Chà, đủ cả ba? Để xem…
The Hero of Gavel#022.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#023.src: They’re all authentic! You must be ri-I mean, you must be a huge fan of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.dst: Đều là hàng thật! Cậu hẳn là gi- à, hẳn là fan cuồng của Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#025.src: Okay, I’ve entered you into the draw. The event’s taking place at the Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.dst: Xong, tôi cho cậu vào bốc thăm rồi. Sự kiện tổ chức ở Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#026.src: Just turn toward the bank and follow the signs, the winner will be selected when everyone gets there.
The Hero of Gavel#026.dst: Cứ rẽ về phía ngân hàng rồi theo biển chỉ, đủ người là sẽ chọn người thắng.
The Hero of Gavel#026.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#027.src: Go to the Golden Eagle Theatre behind the Bank in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the winners to be announced.
The Hero of Gavel#027.dst: Tới Golden Eagle Theatre sau Ngân hàng ở {p} tại [{~}, {~}, -{~}] để nghe công bố người thắng.

The Hero of Gavel#028.src: Welcome, welcome everyone! We’re only waiting on a few more people before we begin.
The Hero of Gavel#028.dst: Chào mừng, chào mừng mọi người! Chỉ đợi thêm vài người nữa là bắt đầu.
The Hero of Gavel#028.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#029.src: Ah, there we go! I believe we’re all set now.
The Hero of Gavel#029.dst: À, đây rồi! Giờ đủ cả rồi.
The Hero of Gavel#029.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#030.src: Welcome everyone, to the monthly SIEGFRIED FESTIVAL SCAVENGER HUNT!
The Hero of Gavel#030.dst: Chào mừng tới CUỘC SĂN KHO BÁU LỄ HỘI SIEGFRIED hằng tháng!
The Hero of Gavel#030.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#031.src: Today, we are once again celebrating the heroic deeds of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.dst: Hôm nay, ta lại tôn vinh chiến công anh hùng của Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#032.src: All of you, my fellow gavellians, have adventured far and wide to gather rare items across the province.
The Hero of Gavel#032.dst: Các bạn, những người con Gavel, đã đi khắp nơi gom đồ hiếm trên toàn tỉnh.
The Hero of Gavel#032.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#033.src: And yet, I cannot announce the winner…
The Hero of Gavel#033.dst: Thế nhưng, tôi không thể công bố…
The Hero of Gavel#033.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#043.src: Thank you all for participating in this fantastic scavenger hunt around Gavel! Siegfried: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
The Hero of Gavel#043.dst: Cảm ơn mọi người đã tham gia cuộc săn kho báu tuyệt vời khắp Gavel! Siegfried: Người thắng sẽ có vinh dự cùng ta tham gia một cuộc phiêu lưu có một không hai, hoàn toàn thật!
The Hero of Gavel#043.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#044.src: Now, without further ado: I shall announce the winner!
The Hero of Gavel#044.dst: Giờ, không dài dòng nữa: ta xin công bố người thắng!
